rows.name: CRISPR
rows.drug: CTX310 — in vivo LNP CRISPR (ANGPTL3 knockdown)
rows.indication: Hypertriglyceridemia / ASCVD risk (in vivo pipeline lead)
rows.cat: CTX310 sHTG Ph1b presented AHA Nov 9; next: CTX611 Ph2 TKA update 2H26
rows.pitch: Ph1b sHTG (n=10) showed day-30 TG -63%, ANGPTL3 -65%, no pancreatitis; durable at 90 days in 7 pts. At $3.9B the cap is 3.7x the $1.1B weighted peak, and CRISPR holds 40% of Casgevy economics.

rows.name: Agios
rows.indication: Sickle cell disease (sNDA under Priority Review, PDUFA Feb 1 2027, extended)
rows.cat: Mitapivat SCD PDUFA Feb 1, 2027 (extended; REMS/labeling open)
rows.pitch: Cash of $907M covers half the $1.8B cap, with approved PKD/thalassemia sales of $55M a quarter. SCD (PDUFA Feb 1, 2027, extended over REMS) had Hb response 40.6% vs 2.9% but no pain-crisis win; Novo's etavopivat follows.

rows.name: Hemab
rows.indication: Von Willebrand disease (first dedicated prophylaxis in development)
rows.cat: HMB-002 VWD additional data at EAHAD Feb 2027; sutacimig FVIID data ASH 12/14/26; SOLARA Ph3 run-in Q4 2026
rows.pitch: Zero treated bleeds in 8 of 9 evaluable patients over 28 days (single-dose cohorts) is early; the $1.8B cap is ~2.7x the $672M weighted peak and 4x cash. Next data at EAHAD Feb 2027.

rows.name: X4
rows.indication: Chronic neutropenia (Ph3 4WARD; the actual thesis — WHIM sales are negligible)
rows.cat: 4WARD (n=126) enrollment complete Q4 2026; topline Q1 2028
rows.pitch: WHIM revenue is $2.9M a quarter, so the $362M cap (cash $188M, debt $77M) rides on 4WARD (n=126, enrollment done Q4 2026, topline Q1 2028); it is ~0.7x our $486M weighted peak, but cheap G-CSF sets the bar.

rows.name: Keros
rows.drug: Rinvatercept (KER-065, renamed) — ActRII ligand trap (+ elritercept/MDS, Takeda)
rows.cat: Rinvatercept Phase 2 DMD initial data
rows.pitch: Cash exceeds the $199M cap by 1.3x, yet cibotercept failed in PAH and rinvatercept has Ph1 healthy-volunteer biomarkers only in DMD. First Ph2 patient dosed Sep 28, data mid-2027, and prior myostatin drugs missed on function; 20% PoS.

rows.name: Autolus
rows.indication: Systemic lupus erythematosus (autoimmune re-rating driver, not the approved ALL indication)
rows.cat: AUTO8 ALARIC initial data at ASH (Dec 2026); LUMINA lupus nephritis Ph2 data 2028; AUCATZYL ramp
rows.pitch: AUCATZYL FY26 guide is $140-150M and lupus has RMAT, so a $304M cap leaves the optionality lightly priced; the catch is $248M cash vs $360M debt and ~6.9 quarters of runway.

rows.name: Cellectis
rows.cat: .HEAL-101 preliminary Phase 1 IIT data (APOC3, sHTG), company guidance 2H 2027
rows.pitch: Pivoted Sep 2026 to in vivo editing, exiting lasme-cel and eti-cel; the APOC3 editor cut TG ~76% in mice, human data 2H 2027. Cash tops the $105M cap; $77M debt.

rows.name: Nurix
rows.cat: Bexobrutideg CLL data at ASH poster Dec 13; CLL-306 Ph3 vs pirtobrutinib enrolling
rows.pitch: Bexobrutideg posted 83% ORR and 22.1mo mPFS (n=47); the cap is 1.4x the ~$1.2B weighted peak, funding runs into 2H 2029, and BeiGene's BGB-16673 is the competing degrader.

rows.name: Allogene
rows.cat: ALPHA3 interim EFS analysis (MRD→relapse-prevention test)
rows.pitch: Cema-cel MRD-negativity was 58% vs 17% with RMAT and Fast Track; the interim EFS in mid-2027 is binary at 30% PoS, though cash into 2029 funds it and the cap is below cash.

rows.name: ADC
rows.cat: LOTIS-5 full Ph3 and LOTIS-7 updated Ph1b oral presentations at ASH, Dec 2026
rows.pitch: The 2L path is being reassessed after the stock fell 57% on LOTIS-5; Zynlonta sells ~$21M a quarter, and Roche and BMS options win on survival. Cap $271M vs $189M cash and $420M debt.

rows.name: Lyell
rows.cat: Updated PiNACLE ronde-cel data (80+ pts) at ASH oral Dec 14 2026; pivotal data mid-2027
rows.pitch: Ronde-cel held CR at 75% at 12 months with ASH oral data on Dec 14 (80+ pts) and pivotal data mid-2027; cap $485M vs $194M cash plus $80M placement, in a crowded CD19 CAR-T field.

rows.name: Atara
rows.drug: Tab-cel (EBVALLO) — EBV-specific allogeneic T-cells; + ATA3219 (allo CD19)
rows.cat: PDUFA Mar 31 2027 for tab-cel resubmission (accepted Oct 14)
rows.pitch: Tab-cel is EU-approved with ~50% ORR in EBV+ PTLD and a US BLA resubmission accepted; but cash of $9.9M, runway into mid-2027 and going-concern risk leave a 1.2x-peak-estimate cap a coin flip.

rows.name: Corvus
rows.indication: Relapsed/refractory peripheral T-cell lymphoma (PTCL) -- lead, registrational; atopic dermatitis is a secondary, non-pivotal Phase 2 program
rows.cat: PTCL Ph3 independent futility analysis (Q1 2027, event-driven); Ph3 topline before end 2027
rows.pitch: Soquelitinib's Ph1 AD data (EASI -72% vs -40% placebo, n=72) are strong, but the registrational asset is a ~150-patient PTCL Ph3 with a Q1 2027 futility analysis. A $982M cap is ~6x our $165M weighted peak against $203M cash.

rows.name: Innate
rows.cat: TELLOMAK-3 first patient expected Q1 2027 (Sobi-partnered)
rows.pitch: Lacutamab showed Sezary ORR 43%, mDOR ~26mo, mPFS 8.3mo; TELLOMAK-3 starts Q1 2027 and runway reaches Q1 2028, so cash covers 92% of the cap while the upside case is thin.

rows.name: Citius Oncology
rows.cat: FY2026 results and 10-K (Lymphir launch metrics) expected Dec 2026; financing need
rows.pitch: Prelim fiscal Q4 showed 792 wholesaler units, 950 vials ordered and 54 institutions (44 in Aug); mogamulizumab dominates CTCL, and a $57M cap with $17M cash needs financing soon.

rows.name: Syndax
rows.cat: Revumenib frontline AML data (BEAT AML, SAVE all-oral, Ph1 chemo combo) guided Q4 2026
rows.pitch: Q3 revenue of $60.7M (+90% y/y) puts Revuforj near a $240M run-rate against an $822M cap; $551M cash roughly offsets $594M debt, so frontline data guided for Q4 2026 sets the upside.

rows.name: Sellas
rows.cat: FDA meeting on filing strategy; BLA submission planned 1H 2027
rows.pitch: REGAL hit OS (24.0 vs 14.7 mo, HR 0.59, p=0.035, n=126) and the stock went +156% in a day, then SELLAS sold $150M at $13 the same night; the ~$2.9B cap is still ~6x our $500M peak, and BLA is 1H27.

rows.name: Kura
rows.cat: ASH Dec 2026 orals: KOMET-008 (Dec 12) and KOMET-007 zifto+quizartinib+7+3 (Dec 14); KOMET-017 topline 2028
rows.pitch: Second to market behind revumenib, Komzifti has 420+ prescriptions (+65%); ASH orals on Dec 12 and Dec 14 on 7+3 combos matter, with cash at 77% of cap but only 7.9 quarters of runway.

rows.name: Omeros
rows.cat: Jan 1 2027 favorable Medicare outpatient reimbursement for 340B YARTEMLEA; continued launch ramp; ARDS and pediatric studies start late 2026/early 2027
rows.pitch: Q3 net sales of $35.9M (+26% vs $28.5M in Q2) and $4.7M non-GAAP net income show a working launch, but the EU CHMP negative stands and a $1.2B cap is ~3.3x our $375M peak estimate; a Jan 1 2027 340B reimbursement change is the next catalyst.

rows.name: Damora
rows.cat: DMR-001 CLARITY-101 first-in-human proof-of-concept data (mid-2027)
rows.pitch: No human data until CLARITY-101 proof-of-concept mid-2027; the $1.8B cap is 3.4x its $529M cash and ~14x the weighted peak. Preclinical 30-fold affinity gain vs Incyte's antibody is the pitch.

rows.name: SL Science
rows.indication: Glioblastoma (GDT cell platform, emerging focus); CD-19 Armed-T blood cancer program stalled on FDA feedback
rows.cat: CD-19 Armed-T pre-IND meeting/IND targeted Q1 2027 (FDA INTERACT feedback Jan 2026 found packages insufficient); gammadelta-T (glioblastoma) IND targeted Q3 2027 pending GLP tox; glioblastoma orphan drug designation request submitted Jul 2026 (FDA acknowledged receipt Mar 30 2026; no decision reported)
rows.pitch: SL Science has no clinical data: FDA found its CD19 Armed-T packages insufficient and the glioblastoma IND is not targeted until Q3 2027. A $404M cap is 50x $8M cash against $1.39M of H1 revenue.

rows.name: Immix
rows.cat: NEXICART-2 final readout and BLA submission (mid-2027)
rows.pitch: NEXICART-2 interim: 40/45 CR, no neurotoxicity, Breakthrough/RMAT; one-year follow-up by Mar 2027. $341M cash after a $125M raise covers 53% of the $645M cap.

rows.name: Legend
rows.cat: CARTITUDE-5/-6 timing not disclosed; LB2501 (in vivo CD19/CD20 CAR-T, B-cell malignancies, not myeloma) Ph1/2 start undated
rows.pitch: A ~$2.8B run-rate, 373 sites and $853M cash against a $3.1B cap look cheap for the best-selling myeloma CAR-T; early deaths in CARTITUDE-4 and CEO turnover explain the gap.

rows.name: Rigel
rows.stage: Commercial (VEPPANU approved May 2026, launched Aug 13); R289 Phase 1b
rows.drug: R289 — oral IRAK1/4 inhibitor (+ commercial TAVALISSE/REZLIDHIA)
rows.cat: R289 RP2D selection by YE2026; ASH oral with Ph1b dose-expansion data (Dec 2026)
rows.pitch: At $823M the cap is 2.8x annualized commercial sales (~$290M: Tavalisse, Rezlidhia, Veppanu) and 8.3x cash; R289's 33-40% TI in a small Ph1b must top the 38-40% of imetelstat and luspatercept before the pipeline earns a premium; ASH Dec 2026.

rows.name: Prelude
rows.drug: PRT12396 — mutant-selective JAK2V617F JH2 inhibitor (Incyte exclusive option partner, Nov 2025); PRT13722 — oral KAT6A-selective degrader (second pillar); no confirmed active oral SMARCA2 degrader (PRT7732/PRT3789) in current pipeline
rows.indication: Polycythemia vera / myelofibrosis (JAK2V617F-mutated MPNs) — lead program; HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer (KAT6A degrader) — second pillar
rows.cat: Incyte option decision on PRT12396 (expires Feb 2027, possible 3-month extension)
rows.pitch: PRT12396 sits under an Incyte option expiring Feb 2027 with first data unguided, and PRT13722 only just entered Ph1; cash is 45% of the $335M cap after a 109% 12-month run.

rows.name: AN2
rows.drug: Epetraborole — oral leucyl-tRNA-synthetase inhibitor (repositioned to PV)
rows.cat: Epetraborole PV Ph2 Part 1 data released periodically throughout 2027; enrollment start by YE 2026
rows.pitch: Repositioned epetraborole has no human PV efficacy; enrollment starts by YE26 and Part 1 data trickle through 2027. A $206M cap is 2.6x cash, so the option is priced modestly.

rows.name: C4
rows.cat: Cemsidomide + elranatamab Ph1b data mid-2027; MOMENTUM initial ORR 2H 2027
rows.pitch: Ph1 showed 53% ORR at RP2D after 7 median priors, durable; elranatamab combo data mid-2027, MOMENTUM ORR 2H27. Cash is 76% of the $361M cap, but BMS CELMoDs set the bar.

rows.name: Geron
rows.cat: RYTELO Germany availability by YE 2026; undated investigator-sponsored/RWE data; no MF path
rows.pitch: IMpactMF was stopped Oct 28, but RYTELO grew to $60.1M (+27% YoY) with $1.4M net income; $339M cash is 49% of the $686M cap, near our $700M peak, and Germany launches by YE26.

rows.name: Enliven
rows.cat: ENABLE-2 Ph3 initiation on track before year-end 2026
rows.pitch: ENABLE-2 Ph3 (n~450 vs TKI) starts before YE26 after 54% MMR in 161 patients; with $884M cash the cap still carries ~$2.7B above it, against Scemblix and generics.

rows.name: Ascentage
rows.cat: US Ph3 progress; global Ph3 interim
rows.pitch: Olverembatinib shows 61% MMR at 2 years in 2L CML and China NRDL was renewed, but US differentiation vs asciminib is unproven. At a $1.2B cap with $280M cash against $309M debt (6/30), the balance sheet is not a cushion.

rows.name: Protagonist
rows.cat: PN-881 Ph2b start early Q1 2027; icotrokinra PsA/UC/CD development ongoing
rows.pitch: Icotrokinra (6-10% royalty) and rusfertide (14-29%) are both approved and a $300M buyback is authorized, yet $9.0B is ~3.6x the $2.5B peak estimate, so uptake must beat expectations.

rows.name: CytomX
rows.cat: CX-2051 mCRC monotherapy Ph1 update with dose selection and registrational strategy, Jan 2027
rows.pitch: At $434M the market pays ~$86M net of $348M cash for CX-2051: 32% cORR, 7.1 mo mPFS, 88% DCR (n=56, 10mg/kg) in 3L+ CRC. Needs randomized confirmation; Jan 2027 update sets dose and registrational plan.

rows.name: Bicycle
rows.cat: Duravelo-2 randomized Ph2 survival data 2H 2027; nuzefatide PDAC Ph2 update in 2027
rows.pitch: A $223M cap vs $470M cash prices zelenectide as nearly dead; Duravelo-2 (randomized Ph2, EV+pembro bar of ~31 mo mOS) reads 2H 2027, with nuzefatide PDAC Ph2 as the free option.

rows.name: Adagene
rows.indication: MSS metastatic colorectal cancer (no liver mets)
rows.cat: Randomized Ph2 dose-optimization ORR results in MSS CRC (1H 2027); sets Ph3 dose
rows.pitch: Cash covers 96% of the $134M cap while muzastotug posted 31% ORR at 20mg/kg (n=26) in MSS CRC, though 10mg/kg fell to 13%. Agenus's exit from MSS-CRC (a strategic funding stop, not futility) helps; 60-patient randomized Ph2 reads 1H 2027.

rows.name: Xilio
rows.drug: XTX501 — tumor-activated bispecific PD-1 / masked IL-2
rows.cat: XTX501 initial Ph1 data in metastatic NSCLC, Q4 2027
rows.pitch: A $152M cap against $122M cash leaves little priced into XTX501 (first patient dosed Oct 2026; NSCLC data Q4 2027). IL-2 has a history of toxicity failures, so masking must show a real therapeutic index.

rows.name: Compass
rows.cat: Further FDA engagement on tovecimig BLA path (undated); CTX-8371 update later 2026
rows.pitch: Trading below cash ($163M vs $119M cap) after the Sep 22 FDA call for an OS trial; the randomized win (ORR 18.0% vs 5.3%, PFS 4.7 vs 2.6 mo) is ignored, though OS missed on 54% crossover.

rows.name: Jazz
rows.drug: Zanidatamab (Ziihera) — HER2 bispecific (+ Xywav, Epidiolex, Zepzelca)
rows.indication: HER2+ gastroesophageal & biliary cancer (+ diversified portfolio)
rows.cat: ABS-1230 KYRON (KCNT1 epilepsy, non-oncology) data 4Q26; Modeyso ACTION OS interim 1H27; Epidiolex capsule PDUFA 4/16/27
rows.pitch: Ziihera won 1L HER2+ GEA (OS HR 0.65) but sold $21M in 3Q26 vs $1.2B total revenue; Zepzelca's 2L LAGOON Ph3 missed OS (1L IMforte unaffected), and a $16B cap makes launch pace upside, not thesis.

rows.name: Zymeworks
rows.cat: Roche ZW209 HSR clearance Q4 2026 and $40M on Ph1b start; R&D Day 2/11/27; ex-US GEA approvals pending
rows.pitch: Ziihera 1L GEA approval (OS HR 0.65) triggered a $250M milestone (received Oct) and 10-20% royalties; the $1.8B cap is 4.6x our $400M peak, against ~$350M cash pro forma and $600M non-recourse notes.

rows.name: NovaBridge
rows.cat: Registrational Ph3 start targeted as early as Q4 2026 (company target, not confirmed)
rows.pitch: Ph1b ORR 75-77% and 82% 6-mo PFS in 1L CLDN18.2 gastric, with FDA-confirmed ORR-based accelerated path and a Ph3 start targeted Q4 2026; $191M cash vs $211M cap, but the data are single-arm.

rows.name: Agenus
rows.cat: ROBBIN Ph3 first patient Q1 2027; interim pathologic response (first 100 pts) Q4 2027
rows.pitch: NEST showed 32% pCR with no recurrences at median 32.2 mo, but ROBBIN Ph3 has not started (first patient Q1 2027) and $85M upfront funds only into Q3 2027; $87M cash vs $239M debt makes dilution the swing factor.

rows.name: Immuneering
rows.cat: Updated 1L PDAC Ph2a data (N=55) 1H 2027; Ph3 topline mid-2028 (may accelerate)
rows.pitch: Single-arm mOS of 17.3 mo (n=55) with the randomized Ph3 enrolling ahead of plan (~570 pts) is cash-backed at $166M vs a $228M cap, but a pan-RAS rival (daraxonrasib) could displace a MEK inhibitor; topline mid-2028.

rows.name: Lantheus
rows.drug: PYLARIFY (piflufolastat F-18) — PSMA-PET imaging (+ PNT2002 radiotherapeutic pipeline)
rows.indication: Prostate cancer imaging (PSMA-PET, market leader) + mCRPC radioligand therapy (PNT2002, SPLASH Ph3)
rows.cat: Curium acquisition close ($102.50 cash + CVR up to $12; 1H 2027, shareholder and regulatory approvals)
rows.pitch: With Curium paying $102.50 cash plus a CVR up to $12 (close 1H 2027), the $7.0B cap tracks deal terms; FTC extended HSR review Oct 21, and Pylarify sales were flat (-0.7%) at $238.9M.

rows.name: Recursion
rows.drug: REC-4881 (MEK inhibitor) — lead of an AI-discovery platform
rows.indication: Familial adenomatous polyposis (hereditary precancerous condition, not cancer) (FAP)
rows.cat: More registrational-trial details later in 2026; registrational trial start expected 2H 2027
rows.pitch: TUPELO: 13/15 had polyp-burden reduction, median -47%, 15% Gr3 TRAEs, in a rare orphan indication (FAP) with no approved drug. $1.7B cap vs $562M cash and a 2H 2027 registrational start.

rows.name: Exelixis
rows.drug: Zanzalintinib — next-gen VEGFR/MET TKI (+ CABOMETYX franchise)
rows.cat: Zanzalintinib mCRC PDUFA Mar 3, 2027; STELLAR-304 nccRCC topline Q1 2027
rows.pitch: The $16B cap is ~4.5x our $3.6B weighted peak for zanzalintinib, whose mCRC OS gain is modest (HR 0.80) against regorafenib, Lonsurf combo and fruquintinib; Mar 3, 2027 PDUFA is largely priced.

rows.name: Cardiff
rows.cat: Ph3 first patient in 1L RAS-mut mCRC (subject to financing)
rows.pitch: Randomized ORR of 72% vs 42% in n=18 vs 19 is small but striking, and the stock is down 63% in 12 months to a $66M cap vs $34M cash; runway is about 4 quarters (through Q3 2027), so Ph3 funding is the real catalyst.

rows.name: Tango
rows.cat: Registrational Ph3 1L MTAP-del PDAC initiation 1H 2027
rows.pitch: Vopimetostat plus daraxonrasib ORR 82% (18/22), 9-mo PFS 88%, but 40% Gr3 TRAEs and a small sample; BMS, Amgen and AZ chase PRMT5, and a Ph3 only starts 1H 2027 at a $4.1B cap.

rows.name: ImmunityBio
rows.cat: BCG-naive NMIBC sBLA submission (QUILT-2.005) planned Q4 2026
rows.pitch: Q3 revenue of $48.7M (+53% YoY) and a papillary label expansion are real, yet the $6.6B cap is 5.1x our $1.3B peak, with $1.3B debt vs $334M cash and cretostimogene closing in.

rows.name: CG Oncology
rows.cat: PIVOT-006 SUO late-breaker Dec 2 2026; BOND-003 Cohort P 12m data Dec 2026; BLA completion by Mar 2027
rows.pitch: PIVOT-006 Ph3 cut recurrence 68% (HR 0.32, no Gr3+ TRAEs) and SUO is Dec 2, yet the $7.1B cap is 2.6x our $2.7B peak; the BLA is not complete until March 2027.

rows.name: Tyra
rows.cat: 2027: BEACH301 achondroplasia initial Ph2 data; SURF302 Ph3 adjuvant start (guided 2027)
rows.pitch: Bladder data (79% ORR, 11/14, no Gr3 related AEs) is a sideshow; $1.7B vs a $595M weighted peak already prices achondroplasia, with $701M cash and BEACH301 data in 2027.

rows.name: Urogen
rows.cat: UGN-103 NDA PDUFA date June 14, 2027
rows.pitch: Revenue of $68.0M (+35% QoQ, 1,538 sites) and a PDUFA on Jun 14, 2027 argue for upside at a $1.4B cap, 1.8x the $800M peak estimate; thin cash ($91M, $189M debt) is the risk.

rows.name: Aktis
rows.cat: AKY-1189 preliminary Ph1b data
rows.pitch: Ph1b AKY-1189 (Ac-225 Nectin-4) has no efficacy data yet and enters against approved enfortumab vedotin (Padcev, since 2019); the $899M cap is 2.9x our $306M weighted peak; $493M cash runs into 2029.

rows.name: Relmada
rows.cat: NDV-01 US IND submission by YE2026; Ph3 SPECTRUM start on clearance
rows.pitch: NDV-01 showed 94% anytime CR (48/51) and 86% 18-mo durability (12/14), yet needs an IND by YE2026 while CGON is ~2 years ahead; cash is $202M, 52% of the $385M cap.

rows.name: Protara
rows.cat: ADVANCED-2 BCG-unresponsive cohort enrollment complete Q4 2026; STARBORN-1 enrollment early Q1 2027
rows.pitch: Stock at exactly cash ($143M) with Breakthrough status and 72% CR any-time (~55% at 12 mo, n=31); differentiation is BCG-sparing, not superior efficacy, and 6.6 quarters of cash is tight.

rows.name: enGene
rows.cat: Pre-BLA FDA meeting and BLA initiation by YE2026 (completion 1H 2027); LEGEND update delivered Nov 2026
rows.pitch: A $132M cap vs $266M cash (debt $33M) discounts weak durability (~25% at 12 mo) vs cretostimogene and Anktiva; 56% any-time CR and a Q4 2026 BLA start give the cash-backed upside.

rows.name: Arcus
rows.cat: PEAK-20 (1L) Ph3 start Q4 2026; PEAK-1 enrollment completion ~Jan-Feb 2027
rows.pitch: Cash of $694M plus a $288M raise runs into 2029 and funds PEAK-1/PEAK-20; 2L mPFS 14.5 mo (n=43) is cross-trial only against Merck's positive Ph3, and the $2.4B cap is 1.5x weighted peak.

rows.name: Xencor
rows.drug: XmAb819 — ENPP3 × CD3 bispecific (+ bispecific platform royalties)
rows.cat: XmAb819 SC data + FDA engagement 1H27; Ph3 start by end 2027
rows.pitch: XmAb819 shows 45.5% confirmed ORR (n=11) with 72.1% Gr3+ related AEs, behind Merck's 52.6%; the $2.7B cap is ~12x our $225M weighted peak and registration work starts only by end 2027.

rows.name: Telix
rows.drug: TLX591-Tx (177Lu-rosopatamab, PSMA rADC) + Illuccix/Gozellix (PSMA-PET imaging, both approved)
rows.cat: Dec 1 2026 Telix shareholder vote on $1.65B ITM acquisition (close by YE2026); ProstACT Global Part 2 readout undated
rows.pitch: Revenue $245M (+19%) is real, yet the $3.0B cap is 2.5x our $1.2B weighted peak, with $252M cash vs $600M debt plus $302M of ITM net debt to be assumed in the $1.65B deal (vote Dec 1) and no ProstACT Part 2 readout date.

rows.name: ORIC
rows.drug: Rinzimetostat (ORIC-944) -- oral EZH2 inhibitor (+ darolutamide, an ARSi supplied by Bayer)
rows.cat: 2H 2026 company program update; Himalayas-1 Ph3 enrolling (no primary readout date guided)
rows.pitch: Rinzimetostat plus darolutamide holds 59% landmark rPFS at 8-10 mo post-abiraterone with no Gr4/5 AEs, and Ph3 is enrolling ~600 pts; $815M cap vs $345M cash, funded into 2H 2028.

rows.name: Janux
rows.cat: Additional JANX007 Ph1b data at a medical congress, 1H 2027
rows.pitch: The $689M cap sits below $946M of cash, leaving the PSMA x CD3 platform free: 30% PR (8/27), rPFS 7.9-8.9mo, no Grade 3 CRS, but earlier BiTEs failed on CRS and the next data is 1H 2027.

rows.name: Candel
rows.cat: BLA submission mid-2027, contingent on FDA dialogue (assay refinement)
rows.pitch: Ph3 in prostate (n=745) cut recurrence or death 30% (HR 0.70, p=0.0155; 38-39% on prostate-cancer-specific DFS), with SPA, RMAT and Fast Track, but the BLA slipped to mid-2027 on assay work; $450M cap vs $203M cash, single-trial risk.

rows.name: Celcuity
rows.cat: FDA action on PIK3CA-mutant sNDA (PDUFA Jun 25 2027); first launch sales with Q4 results
rows.pitch: REVTORPYK cut progression/death 76% (HR ~0.24) and launched Sep 30 with no direct wild-type rival; $643M cash vs $754M debt, and the PIK3CA-mutant sNDA is the next lever on a $3.3B cap.

rows.name: Relay
rows.cat: ASH Dec 14 2026: ReInspire data in PIK3CA vascular anomalies (non-breast); breast Ph3 ReDiscover-2 enrolling; YE2026 1L Ph3 design confirmation
rows.pitch: Zovegalisib's 11.1mo mPFS (n=57) and Breakthrough status are real, but cross-trial; $3.8B cap vs $849M cash and Ph3 ReDiscover-2 against approved capivasertib leave little room; the Dec 14 ASH data are vascular anomalies, not breast.

rows.name: Olema
rows.cat: OPERA-01 Ph3 topline Q1 2027
rows.pitch: Cash of $414M covers 56% of the $744M cap into the binary OPERA-01 topline (Q1 2027, slipped from fall 2026); the cap is 0.7x our weighted peak, but elacestrant and camizestrant set the bar.

rows.name: Arvinas
rows.drug: ARV-102 -- brain-penetrant LRRK2 degrader (PROTAC); + out-licensed vepdegestrant (VEPPANU) royalty -- FDA-approved May 2026, now being re-out-licensed to a new third-party commercial partner (Pfizer stepping back from direct commercialization)
rows.cat: ARV-393 initial monotherapy data at ASH (Dec 12-15, 2026); ARV-102 PSP EU CTA 4Q26
rows.pitch: Trading at 0.8x cash with no debt, and ARV-102 shows >50% LRRK2 knockdown sustained 28 days; clinical benefit is unproven, Denali's LRRK2 inhibitor is further along, and the US IND is on hold.

rows.name: Greenwich
rows.drug: GLSI-100 (GP2 peptide + GM-CSF) — HER2 cancer vaccine
rows.indication: HER2+ early-stage breast cancer (adjuvant, recurrence prevention)
rows.cat: FLAMINGO-01 first interim at 28 events (event-driven, undated)
rows.pitch: FLAMINGO-01 is a real Ph3 (target HR 0.55, interim at 28 events), but the Ph2 was small and the $202M cap runs on $6M cash, a ~$2M quarterly burn and late filings; wait for funding.

rows.name: ALX
rows.cat: ASPEN-09-Breast Ph2 topline (~120 pts) 2H 2027; ALX2004 Ph1 data Dec 2026
rows.pitch: Evorpacept plus HER2 antibodies hit 65.0% ORR vs 26.1% in CD47-high gastric (n=43); cap of $138M is below $153M cash, funded to 1H 2028, with ASPEN-09-Breast topline 2H 2027.

rows.name: OnKure
rows.cat: OKI-345 IND filing (H1 2027)
rows.pitch: OnKure reset to preclinical after deprioritizing OKI-219; OKI-345 IND is H1 2027, 1+ year behind zovegalisib (Ph3) and approved PI3K rivals, so 1.2x cash cover does not make this a buy.

rows.name: Acrivon
rows.cat: Prespecified Arms 3+4 interim analysis plus Arm 1 update; complete enrollment of Arm 3 or 4 (Q4 2026)
rows.pitch: The $63M cap is under $78M cash while Arms 3+4 interim and an Arm 1 update land in Q4 2026; Fast Track and no direct CHK1 rival help, but biomarker selection must hold; runway is 4.9 quarters.

rows.name: Corcept
rows.cat: Relacorilant Cushing's NDA PDUFA Dec 17 2026; EC decision on Lifyorli ovarian by YE2026
rows.pitch: Lifyorli posted $91.4M in Q3 on ROSELLA (mOS 16.0 vs 11.9 mo, HR 0.65) and Korlym plus its authorized generic grew 19% q/q to $249M; Cushing's PDUFA is Dec 17, but an $8.7B cap is 2.9x our peak estimate.

rows.name: Verastem
rows.drug: VS-7375 (GFH375) - oral KRAS G12D(ON/OFF) inhibitor; plus marketed AVMAPKI FAKZYNJA (LGSOC)
rows.indication: KRAS G12D-mutant pancreatic cancer (2L and 1L), NSCLC, colorectal cancer; marketed: recurrent LGSOC
rows.cat: TARGET-D 301 1L PDAC Ph3 start by YE2026; blister-pack FDA decision Feb 7 2027; VS-7375 data early-mid 2027
rows.pitch: VS-7375, an oral KRAS G12D(ON/OFF) inhibitor, is the real driver: 41% confirmed ORR in 2L+ PDAC and a 1L PDAC Ph3 start by YE26. The LGSOC launch ($24M Q3) funds it, but a $1.3B cap leaves little room before data.

rows.name: MacroGenics
rows.indication: Advanced solid tumors - SCCHN lead expansion cohort (also endometrial, melanoma cohorts)
rows.cat: MGC026 SCCHN cohort updated data (mid-2027); enrollment completes YE2026
rows.pitch: MGC026 has cleared SCCHN Stage 1 (n=74 enrolled, no ILD or ocular toxicity), but ifinatamab deruxtecan is ~2 years ahead and MacroGenics' prior ADCs disappointed; cash $288M vs $139M cap.

rows.name: Zentalis
rows.cat: DENALI Part 2 integrated topline readout (registration-intent) — now guided 1H 2027
rows.pitch: Cyclin E1+ PROC showed median OS 15.9 mo (n=48) vs 7.5 mo in E1-; with the pivotal topline slipped to 1H 2027 and only ~5 quarters of runway, the cap sits below cash but financing looms.

rows.name: Compugen
rows.cat: MAIA-ovarian randomized maintenance results by end of Q1 2027
rows.pitch: MAIA-ovarian (62 pts, 2:1 vs placebo) reads out by end of Q1 2027; $118M cash covers 61% of the $193M cap, so downside looks cushioned, but we put PoS at 11% and wait for the data.

rows.name: Genelux
rows.cat: Ph3 OnPrime/GOG-3076 topline
rows.pitch: OnPrime topline is due by year-end, but $10M cash is 11% of the $92M cap, oncolytic viruses have an uneven record and mirvetuximab holds the FRa+ lane; cap exceeds our ~$71M weighted peak.

rows.name: Anixa
rows.cat: Further lira-cel dose-cohort updates; vaccine Ph2 start after FDA consultation (no dates guided)
rows.pitch: No confirmed RECIST responses after 14 CAR-T patients over four years, TNBC vaccine Ph2 undated, and $14M cash against an $89M cap; dilution looks near-certain and our PoS is 6%.

rows.name: PMV
rows.cat: ENA 2026 late-breaking oral; NDA submission planned Q1 2027
rows.pitch: Rezatapopt posted 46% ORR (35/76, median DOR 10.0 mo) in TP53 Y220C ovarian with no approved rival; $90M cap is 0.8x cash and ~0.65x the ~$139M weighted peak, though runway is just 6 quarters.

rows.name: Faeth (ex-Sensei)
rows.cat: Regulatory feedback on registrational Ph3 design for PIKTOR (timing not guided)
rows.pitch: PIK-201 Ph2 showed 33% confirmed ORR (12/36; 44% in PIK3CA-mutant), 7.4 mo mPFS and 64% Gr3+ TRAEs, single-arm; $175M cash vs a $241M cap gives support while Ph3 design awaits FDA.

rows.name: Nanobiotix
rows.cat: NANORAY-312 Ph3 -- FDA-cleared protocol amendment (interim analysis dropped, fewer events needed) accelerates path to final analysis
rows.pitch: NANORAY-312 dropped its interim, so the final analysis comes sooner with fewer events, but the $1.5B cap is 11.6x the $126M cash and ~24x weighted peak; evidence is single-arm Ph1 (mOS 23 vs ~12mo).

rows.name: Bicara
rows.drug: Ficerafusp alfa — EGFR × TGF-β bispecific (+ pembro)
rows.cat: FORTIFI-HN01 interim analysis topline, mid-2027
rows.pitch: Ficerafusp alfa shows 48-54% cORR and 21.3-mo mOS vs pembrolizumab's 19% ORR, and $442M cash covers 66% of the $669M cap, but it is single-arm; FORTIFI-HN01 interim topline mid-2027 is the proof.

rows.name: Coherus
rows.cat: Casdozokitug Ph2 1L uHCC first data readout (1H 2027)
rows.pitch: Cap of $82M is level with $84M cash and Loqtorzi earned $14.0M in Q3 (OS HR 0.62), but $53M debt, 2.5 quarters of runway and a ~3,000-patient US NPC market make the casdozokitug HCC data in 1H27 the swing.

rows.name: Pyxis
rows.cat: Dec 2026 corporate update with 1L MICVO + pembrolizumab data (at least 20 pts); EOP2 FDA feedback Q1 2027
rows.pitch: MICVO monotherapy: 36% cORR, 94% DCR, mPFS 6.2mo (n=33); 30% x $750M is ~$225M vs $169M cap, with Dec 2026 1L pembro data and Q1 2027 FDA EOP2 feedback ahead, and $57M cash (9/30) predates an ~$110M Oct raise.

rows.name: Corbus
rows.cat: CRB-701 plus Keytruda 1L OPSCC combination data (Q1 2027)
rows.pitch: CRB-701 (42.9% cORR in 2L OPSCC) is in a registrational trial since Sep 29, yet the stock fell 39% on a modest 5% obesity readout for CRB-913; $115M cash is ~2.7x the $42M cap.

rows.name: PDS
rows.stage: Phase 2 (PDS0301 IL-12 immunocytokine, NCI-led mCRC); PDS0101 Ph3 discontinued
rows.indication: MSS/pMMR metastatic colorectal cancer (+ liver mets)
rows.cat: PDS0301 registrational Ph3 protocol submission to FDA (undated; triggers remaining PIPE closing)
rows.pitch: A 71% ORR and 80% 24-mo survival in a small NCI-run MSS CRC Ph2 is unconfirmed; with $15M cash (about 3.6 quarters) vs a $67M cap and an up-to-$22.3M PIPE (only ~$11.3M closed, rest tied to the Ph3 protocol), wait for the filing.

rows.name: Summit
rows.indication: EGFR-mutant NSCLC, post-TKI (2L+) — combo with chemo; broader 1L populations (HARMONi-3/-6/-7) still Phase 3
rows.cat: Post-CRL path for ivonescimab BLA; HARMONi-3 and HARMONi-7 Phase 3 progress (no dates guided)
rows.pitch: The FDA CRL cites no significant OS benefit (HR 0.79, 95% CI 0.62-1.01) despite PFS HR 0.52; $9.8B is 2.3x our $4.2B peak and 15.6x $630M cash, resting on undated HARMONi-3 and -7.

rows.name: Nuvation
rows.cat: Q4/FY2026 IBTROZI sales report with FY results, ~Q1 2027
rows.pitch: A best-in-class ROS1 TKI with Q3 sales of $27.5M (+18% QoQ) and 49.7mo mDOR, yet the $1.4B cap is ~3.5x the $385M peak and $454M debt offsets much of $663M cash; wait for a better entry.

rows.name: Arrivent
rows.indication: 1L EGFR PACC-mutant NSCLC (ALPACCA); ex20ins FURVENT missed PFS
rows.cat: Firmonertinib update after FURVENT data review (Q1 2027); ALPACCA Ph3 ongoing, interim ORR analysis undated
rows.pitch: After FURVENT missed PFS (HR 0.75, p=0.0654, despite 60% vs 33% ORR), Dizal/AstraZeneca's sunvozertinib leads 1L ex20ins; $393M cash is 65% of the $602M cap, leaving ALPACCA as the remaining thesis, with a Q1 2027 update.

rows.name: Cullinan
rows.indication: Treatment-refractory SLE, difficult-to-treat RA and Sjogren's disease
rows.cat: December 2026 webcast: CLN-978 multi-dose data (~20 pts across SLE, RA, SjD) and first single-dose SjD data
rows.pitch: After netting $314M cash, ~$300M of value rides on CLN-978 (10/14 SLE pts with a 4+ point hSLEDAI drop at EULAR, one Grade 3 CRS); December multi-dose data and the Feb 27 zipalertinib PDUFA are next.

rows.name: BridgeBio Oncology
rows.cat: Q4 2026 BBO-11818 and BBO-10203 monotherapy updates; BBO-8520 2L+ NSCLC combo data through mid-2027 (no dated readout)
rows.pitch: BBO-8520 shows 63% ORR in G12C-naive (n=41) and 75% at 500mg QD with pembrolizumab (53% across doses, n=17) in G12C-experienced patients, yet $315M cash is 2x the $159M cap; n and follow-up trail Amgen, BMS and Roche.

rows.name: Crescent
rows.indication: NSCLC + gastrointestinal and gynecological cancers (1L and previously treated, ASCEND trial)
rows.cat: CR-001 ASCEND Ph1/2 proof-of-concept data (Q1 2027)
rows.pitch: CR-001 has no human efficacy data, and the $617M cap is 2.1x $289M cash for a PD-1xVEGF fast follower trailing ivonescimab by 14-16 months; ASCEND proof-of-concept data in Q1 2027 must clear that bar.

rows.name: Nuvectis
rows.cat: FDA update on NXP100 US PNH path and US IND by YE2026; China anti-C5-pretreated PNH approval 1Q27
rows.pitch: A China-approved oral factor B inhibitor with 94.6% vs 69.4% transfusion-free over eculizumab; the stock has nearly tripled in 12 months, and the US IND by YE26 must show differentiation from Fabhalta.

rows.name: Sutro
rows.indication: Advanced solid tumors, broadly (Ph1 dose escalation, no tumor-type restriction yet)
rows.cat: STRO-004 STRIVE-01 next data update (1H 2027)
rows.pitch: STRO-004 shows partial responses in three tumor types (n=49) but discloses no ORR or PFS, while Tivdak is approved; $249M debt offsets $142M cash against a $155M cap, with data in 1H 2027.

rows.name: Foghorn
rows.drug: Selective EP300 degrader - small-molecule targeted protein degrader
rows.cat: EP300 degrader IND filing, targeted 2027
rows.pitch: Lilly ended FHD-909 in Oct 2026, leaving a preclinical EP300 degrader (IND 2027, no human data); 1.2x cash cover sits against 7.4 quarters of runway, so burn eats the floor.

rows.name: Whitehawk
rows.cat: HWK-007 Ph1 initial data, 1H 2027
rows.pitch: HWK-007 has no human efficacy yet and PTK7 ADCs have failed before; the $283M cap is ~12x the $23M weighted peak (5.9% x $390M), with $170M cash and first data due 1H 2027.

rows.name: Black Diamond
rows.cat: Potential Ph3 start Q2 2027 after Cohort 4 (150mg) safety data submitted to FDA
rows.pitch: Market cap of $88M sits below $102M cash while silevertinib shows 60% ORR, 15.0-mo mPFS and 86% CNS ORR (n=43 at 200mg); 150mg data are unreported and firmonertinib's 16-mo mPFS is the bar.

rows.name: MAIA
rows.cat: THIO-104 Ph3 interim survival analysis, 2027 (month not guided)
rows.pitch: THIO-101 Part C: 88% DCR (38/43) in 3L+ NSCLC; 27.5% x $560M is ~$154M vs a $61M cap, with Ph3 THIO-104 interim survival in 2027, though $21M cash needs to be raised first.

rows.name: Eikon
rows.cat: TeLuRide-008 Ph2/3 interim analysis for dose selection, 2H 2027
rows.pitch: EIK1001 + pembro + chemo showed 63.1% ORR (n=65) vs ~40-47% for SoC, but single-arm; the $292M cap is under $462M cash, and the randomized Ph2/3 interim (2H 2027) is the real test.

rows.name: Zai Lab
rows.drug: Zocilurtatug pelitecan (zoci) — DLL3 ADC (+ diversified China portfolio)
rows.cat: Global 1L ES-SCLC Ph3 start by YE2026; epNEC topline 1H 2027; DLLEVATE interim 2H 2027
rows.pitch: Zoci's 1L SCLC Ph1 (ORR 81.8%, n=33) is strong, but $2.6B also capitalizes a $108M-a-quarter China business; tarlatamab sets the bar, and DLLEVATE interim is 2H27, so patience is warranted.

rows.name: Puma
rows.drug: NERLYNX (neratinib) — pan-HER TKI (+ alisertib, Aurora-A kinase inhibitor)
rows.indication: Early-stage & metastatic HER2+ breast cancer (extended adjuvant + combination)
rows.cat: Updated ALISCA-Breast1 alisertib data at SABCS (Dec 8-11 2026)
rows.pitch: NERLYNX Q3 revenue was $54.1M (+4% YoY) with $20-22M of guided FY26 net income and $109M cash, but a mature base and weak alisertib SCLC signals leave the $390M cap exposed.

rows.name: Molecular Partners
rows.cat: MP0712 initial safety data at NACLC, Dec 2026
rows.pitch: MP0712 cleared dose level 1 with no DLTs and dose level 2 is fully dosing; the $103M cap is ~4x the ~$27M weighted peak (10.6% x $250M), so efficacy in 2027 is what matters.

rows.name: Immatics
rows.cat: SUPRAME final PFS topline in 1H 2027, followed by BLA submission in 2027
rows.pitch: Cash of $536M covers 55% of the $966M cap, so the market pays about $430M for anzu-cel (56% cORR, 14.6-month mDOR) versus our ~$810M weighted peak; lifileucel is about 1.5 years ahead.

rows.name: Immunocore
rows.drug: Tebentafusp (KIMMTRAK) + brenetafusp — TCR × CD3 ImmTAC bispecifics
rows.cat: TEBE-AM Ph3 (2L+ cutaneous melanoma) topline OS expected Q2 2027
rows.pitch: Q3 Kimmtrak sales of $102.2M (YTD $324.8M) and $901M cash vs $403M debt underpin a $1.5B cap; upside rests on TEBE-AM OS (Q2 2027) and brenetafusp breaking the uveal ceiling.

rows.name: Iovance
rows.cat: UK MHRA and Swissmedic Amtagvi approval decisions potentially 1Q27; NSCLC sBLA 2027; FY26 revenue $410-420M
rows.pitch: Q3 revenue of $122M (+80% YoY, ~60% gross margin) and a HLA-unrestricted label back a $3.5B cap; cash is $382M, so the NSCLC sBLA (2027) and ex-US approvals must extend the ramp.

rows.name: Replimune
rows.drug: TUDRIQEV (vusolimogene oderparepvec-wtpg, formerly RP1) — oncolytic HSV (+ nivolumab)
rows.cat: First Tudriqev product revenue (fiscal Q3, quarter ending Dec 2026); permanent J-code expected Apr 2027
rows.pitch: Tudriqev's launch is the test: IGNYTE showed 24.2% ORR with 14.1-month mDOR, cap is $2.4B vs $308M cash and $100M debt, and the stock has roughly doubled in a year; hold for first sales.

rows.name: Sol-Gel
rows.cat: SGT-610 Ph3 topline readout (late Nov 2026)
rows.pitch: Patidegib's Ph3 topline lands in late November with a 9% dropout rate and US rights retained, but a $180M cap is 3.3x our $54M weighted peak, so the payoff skews to a miss.

rows.name: TuHURA
rows.cat: Preliminary front-line IFx-2.0 MCC data 1H 2027; Ph3 enrollment completion 2H 2027; MCC orphan designation expected 2H 2026
rows.pitch: Preliminary MCC data are due 1H 2027, but Ph3 enrollment has slipped to 2H 2027 and cash is $2M vs $9M debt (0.3 quarters of runway), so a raise is near-certain before either.

rows.name: Alpha Tau
rows.drug: Alpha DaRT (Ra-224 diffusing alpha radiotherapy) — implanted seeds
rows.cat: ReSTART cSCC pivotal topline (late 2026-early 2027) + modular PMA (1st module filed Jan 2026)
rows.pitch: ReSTART (n=88, single-arm) has not reported efficacy, yet the stock carries $1.2B vs $105M cash and 7 quarters of runway; even a good readout has little room, a stumble has plenty of downside.

rows.name: NeOnc
rows.cat: NEO100 Type B end-of-phase FDA meeting (accelerated approval path, Ph3); NEO212 EOP1 FDA meeting Nov 17 2026 (outcome pending)
rows.pitch: NEO100's 48.9% 6-month PFS vs a 20% benchmark (n=24, single-arm) is encouraging, but $2M cash and ~0.4 quarters of runway put dilution ahead of the FDA meeting; $113M is 2.8x the $40M peak estimate.

rows.name: Kazia
rows.indication: Metastatic breast cancer — TNBC (Ph1b, paxalisib + pembrolizumab + chemo) plus newly added HR+/HER2- cohort (Sep 2026); GBM (registrational discussions ongoing post-GBM-AGILE)
rows.cat: SABCS Dec 2026 paxalisib posters; Ph1b interim updates; enrollment complete by Jul 2027
rows.pitch: TNBC Ph1b showed 5 of 6 evaluable responders (1 CR, 4 PR) with no paxalisib-related SAEs, yet n is tiny, GBM missed its primary, and enrollment runs to Jul 2027; $40M cash vs an $87M cap.

rows.name: Ideaya
rows.cat: FDA acceptance and PDUFA date for darovasertib+crizotinib NDA (submitted Q3 2026, RTOR); date not yet announced
rows.pitch: OptimUM-02 (n=313) showed mPFS 6.9 vs 3.1 months, HR 0.42, and the NDA is under RTOR; yet $3.1B vs $1.15B cash prices platform value beyond a small uveal market, so we wait.

rows.name: Aura
rows.cat: CoMpass Ph3 topline (15-month primary endpoint) 2H 2027; choroidal mets/ocular surface update Q1 2027
rows.pitch: CoMpass enrolled 108 patients (above target) under an SPA with topline 2H 2027, and bel-sar faces no approved vision-sparing 1L rival; still, an $802M cap vs $297M cash leaves limited room before the binary.

rows.name: Erasca
rows.cat: ERAS-0015 AURORAS-1 oral at ENA Nov 20 (12:30 CET); ERAS-4001 prelim mono data 2H26
rows.pitch: ERAS-0015 shows 57% uORR (n=7) in PDAC and 62% (n=37) in NSCLC, unconfirmed and early; $5.3B is 8x the $648M weighted peak (18% x $3.6B) with Ph3s not starting until 2027. ENA oral Nov 20.

rows.name: Adlai Nortye
rows.cat: AN9025 initial Ph1a QD dose-escalation data (possible QW early look) 1H27
rows.pitch: AN9025 (pan-RAS) has no efficacy data yet; first data 1H27. A $646M cap is 2.8x cash and ~13x the ~$51M weighted peak (5% x $1.0B), against randomized Ph3 data at Revolution Medicines.

rows.name: Immunome
rows.cat: Varegacestat desmoid PDUFA (Apr 2027)
rows.pitch: RINGSIDE (n=156) cut progression risk 84% and hit every key endpoint; PDUFA is Apr 28, 2027 and EMA has validated the MAA. Nirogacestat is the incumbent, and $462M cash vs a $2.0B cap funds the launch into 2028.

rows.name: Inhibrx
rows.cat: Ozekibart BLA PDUFA decision (April 14, 2027); chondrosarcoma would be first approved systemic therapy; CRC combo data ongoing
rows.pitch: Ozekibart doubled PFS (5.52 vs 2.66 mo, HR 0.479, n=206) and PDUFA is Apr 14, 2027, yet a $1.2B cap is 6.1x cash, debt is $277M, and a hepatotoxicity signal plus a rare-tumor market cap the upside.

rows.name: Fennec
rows.indication: Cisplatin-induced hearing loss (pediatric) (supportive care: otoprotectant, not an anticancer therapy)
rows.cat: Q4 2026 PEDMARK sales ramp (AYA growth); no label-expansion timeline disclosed
rows.pitch: PEDMARK Q3 net sales rose 56% to $19.4M with $5.8M adj EBITDA, and cash is $49M. Yet the $484M cap is 3.2x our $150M peak, so a niche, formulary-driven ramp is needed just to hold value.

rows.name: Parabilis
rows.indication: Desmoid tumors (lead); also active in adamantinomatous craniopharyngioma, ameloblastoma, salivary gland cancer, solid pseudopapillary neoplasm, HCC, FAP; rationale for combo in MSS CRC
rows.cat: PEDESTAL randomized Ph3 registrational start 1H 2027 (topline 2029); ACP update 1H 2027
rows.pitch: Zolucatetide hit 72.2% ORR (13/18) at 32 weeks with no AE discontinuations, and FDA aligned on Ph3. But $3.6B is 3.3x cash and 4.7x weighted peak, and PEDESTAL reads out only in 2029.

rows.name: Milestone
rows.cat: ReVeRA-301 AFib-RVR Ph3 topline 2H 2028; cost cuts complete Q1 2027
rows.pitch: At $52M vs $145M cash (and $143M debt), the market prices CARDAMYST's launch as a failure: Q3 sales $1.0M, +73% q/q, with free off-label propafenone the habit to beat; Q3 net loss was $25.8M.

rows.name: Kardigan
rows.cat: KINSHIP-DCM Ph2b topline 2Q 2027
rows.pitch: Danicamtiv's DCM data are open-label Ph2a (n=41, no placebo), so 'best efficacy' is not shown; the real test is KINSHIP-DCM Ph2b in 2Q27. $591M cash is 49% of the $1.2B cap, 1.9x the $618M weighted peak (20.6% x $3B).

rows.name: BridgeBio
rows.cat: BBP-418 LGMD2I/R9 FDA decision (PDUFA 11/27/26); Attruby ramp (Q3 $253M); infigratinib PDUFA 2/4/27
rows.pitch: Attruby Q3 revenue of $253.2M (+~$145M y/y) is a real launch, but a $15B cap is 2.4x the $6.4B peak estimate; three Priority Review PDUFAs (Nov 27, Feb 4, May 8) follow, with tafamidis holding share.

rows.name: Cytokinetics
rows.cat: nHCM sNDA submission (ACACIA-HCM) Q4 2026
rows.pitch: MYQORZO's Nov-16 label update (MAPLE-HCM met primary pVO2 vs metoprolol) and a Q4 nHCM sNDA favor CYTK near term; the $7.2B cap is 2.1x the $3.4B peak estimate, with ~$2B of debt-like liabilities and a hypertension signal (15% vs 3%).

rows.name: Lexeo
rows.cat: SUNRISE-FA2 topline data (Part 1)
rows.pitch: At 1.3x cash ($293M cap vs $234M) the market pays little for LX2006's frataxin +115% data; the 13-vs-13 pivotal reads in Aug 2027, BLA 2028, and nomlabofusp's BLA is ~18 months ahead.

rows.name: Rocket
rows.cat: RP-A501 pivotal Ph2 dosing completion (topline mid-2028)
rows.pitch: A $241M cap is 0.9x cash, so the market ascribes little to Danon gene therapy RP-A501 despite FDA alignment on a pivotal Ph2 (success = 7/12); topline mid-2028, and a past clinical hold and AAV safety remain the overhang.

rows.name: Larimar
rows.cat: FDA BLA acceptance early 2027; open-label safety update Q1 2027; approval targeted mid-2027
rows.pitch: BLA submitted Nov 16 (acceptance early 2027, approval targeted mid-2027) on a surrogate; the $329M cap is near the ~$328M weighted peak, while $129M cash and 4.7 quarters of runway force a raise.

rows.name: Atrium
rows.drug: ATR-1072 — siRNA targeting PRKAG2 (+ ATR-1086 for PLN cardiomyopathy)
rows.cat: ATR-1072 Corventis Ph1/2 initial proof-of-concept data 2H 2027
rows.pitch: The 2.2x cash-to-cap discount ($232M vs $105M) is real, but ATR-1072 only just dosed its first patient with no human data until 2H 2027; ~$23M of weighted value (11% PoS x $210M) does not support a re-rating. Verify ticker.

rows.name: Tenaya
rows.cat: MyPEAK-1 Cohort 2 1-yr and Cohort 1 2-yr data plus pivotal plan update by year-end 2026
rows.pitch: NYHA improved >=1 class in 5/6 patients and EMA PRIME was granted, yet n=6 and AAV durability risk, $67M cash and 3.9 quarters of runway mean financing follows the year-end 2026 pivotal-design update.

rows.name: Longeveron
rows.stage: Phase 2b complete (ELPIS II) — missed primary endpoint
rows.indication: Hypoplastic left heart syndrome (HLHS) — under strategic review after missed Ph2b endpoint; also longevity/frailty and Alzheimer's
rows.cat: FDA meeting on HLHS path (requested, unscheduled) / strategic review outcome; cash runway into Q1 2027
rows.pitch: ELPIS II (n=40) missed primary RVEF at Month 12 (p=0.8336); a MACE signal (1 vs 8) is secondary, the FDA meeting is unscheduled, and $7.2M cash lasts into Q1 2027 against a $68M cap, so dilution looks likely.

rows.name: Mineralys
rows.cat: Lorundrostat FDA PDUFA decision (Dec 22, 2026)
rows.pitch: Two positive pivotals and a Dec-22 PDUFA at 90% PoS; the $1.3B cap (2.1x $625M cash) is 0.5x the $2.8B peak, though as #2 behind AstraZeneca's approved baxdrostat, payer terms set the ramp.

rows.name: DiaMedica
rows.cat: ReMEDy2 interim analysis (DSMB review of first 200 pts) expected Q1 2027
rows.pitch: ReMEDy2 has no topline; the Q1 2027 DSMB interim may only re-size the trial (300-728 pts), which would need more money than $35M cash with ~4 quarters runway, against a $449M cap at 3.8x weighted peak (13% x $900M).

rows.name: Liquidia
rows.cat: SPRINT (3x/4x daily dosing) initiation 4Q 2026; FDA action on PH-ILD label removal
rows.pitch: Q3 YUTREPIA sales $222.7M (+31% q/q) with $140.5M adj. EBITDA, yet a $5.0B cap is 2.4x the $2.1B peak estimate while the '327 remedy and appeal could cut PH-ILD and Tyvaso DPI holds share.

rows.name: Tectonic
rows.cat: APEX Ph2 topline expected by end of January 2027
rows.pitch: Binary APEX Ph2 (n=191, 72% enriched CpcPH) by end of Jan 2027: a $413M cap is 1.8x cash and 0.8x the ~$500M weighted peak, yet sotatercept's CADENCE PVR win (p=0.004) narrows TX45's window.

rows.name: Tenax
rows.cat: FDA Type C outcome, LEVEL-2 protocol paper and development update (Q1 2027)
rows.pitch: After the failed LEVEL Ph3 (n=241, p=0.63), the case rests on a nominal subgroup (+26.3m, p=0.011, n=119) and an FDA Type C outcome in Q1 2027; $85M cap vs $114M cash does not make up for that.

rows.name: Inhibikase
rows.cat: IMPROVE-PAH Part A interim safety readout (n=50), 1H 2027
rows.pitch: No efficacy data yet for an imatinib prodrug in PAH; Part A (n=50) in 1H27 is safety only, the $291M cap is 1.5x the $193M cash, and any add-on must beat sotatercept's data with tolerability that sank Gleevec.

rows.name: Gossamer
rows.cat: FDA decision on NDA filing acceptance (company: 2026; unlocks ~$125M financing tranche)
rows.pitch: After PROSERA's miss (+13.3m 6MWD, p=0.032 vs 0.025), a single-trial NDA faces sotatercept's entrenched bar. Cap is now ~$67M on corrected share count against $57M cash, $84M debt and ~1.4 quarters of runway; a binary NDA outcome.

rows.name: Humacyte
rows.drug: ATEV — acellular tissue-engineered vessel (bioengineered blood vessel)
rows.cat: Dialysis-access sBLA filing
rows.pitch: Approved with Q3 Symvess sales of only $1.0M, but three positive Ph3s and a Nov-30 dialysis sBLA filing target; the $150M cap is ~0.3x the $540M weighted peak against $65M cash and $37M debt, so dilution risk is high.

rows.name: Palvella
rows.drug: QTORIN rapamycin 3.9% gel — topical mTOR inhibitor
rows.cat: QTORIN rapamycin PDUFA Feb 28 2027 (Priority Review)
rows.pitch: Approval at 97% PoS looks near-certain (SELVA n=49, 2.13-pt IGA gain, p<0.001), but the $2.3B cap is 1.5x the $1.6B peak and QTORIN must justify orphan pricing against ~$100/yr generic sirolimus.

rows.name: Sagimet
rows.indication: Acne (China Ph3 positive + US Ph3 planned; now the PRIMARY focus); MASH (deprioritized)
rows.cat: AURORA US Ph3 acne topline, guided 2H 2027
rows.pitch: Denifanstat won a 480-patient China Ph3 and the US AURORA Ph3 (~800 pts) dosed in Oct; cash of $258M funds to mid-2029, but the $742M cap is 1.2x our $640M weighted peak, so execution must pay.

rows.name: Veradermics
rows.cat: Female Study 306 topline 1H 2027; NDA submission timing undisclosed
rows.pitch: Study 302 gave +43.9 hairs/cm2 at 12 months (BID) with no treatment-related SAEs, yet the $5.3B cap is 2.5x our $2.1B weighted peak, and branded pricing must beat ~$15/month generic minoxidil.

rows.name: Absci
rows.cat: ABS-201 HEADLINE 13-week interim PoC data in AGA, guided December 2026
rows.pitch: Only SAD safety and a ~65-day half-life exist so far, yet the $1.3B cap is ~4x the $325M weighted peak (13% x $2.5B); the Dec 2026 13-week AGA interim must also face finasteride and MANE's VDPHL01.

rows.name: Conexeu
rows.drug: CXU — injectable collagen ECM scaffold ("Ten Minute Tissue")
rows.cat: CXU 510(k) submission
rows.pitch: CXU has only unreviewed preclinical data, $7M of cash (3.8 quarters) on a $59M cap, and a 510(k) not expected until early 2027, against commercial filler makers; funding precedes any revenue.

rows.name: Krystal
rows.drug: VYJUVEK (beremagene, B-VEC) — topical redosable gene therapy
rows.cat: KB111 HALITE-1 interim before YE2026; KB803 IOLITE topline shortly after Feb 2027 LPV
rows.pitch: VYJUVEK sales are $127.3M (+30%, up from $119.2M) with $1.2B cash, yet the $8.8B cap is 7.5x our $1.18B weighted peak; KB111 interim by YE26 and a rare DEB population limit room.

rows.name: Abeona
rows.cat: More QTC treatments and revenue ramp; no guided date (Q4 2026 results next)
rows.pitch: Q3 ZEVASKYN sales of $13.5M (+18% q/q, 15 treatments since launch, 8 QTCs) against a $161M cap that is 1.2x cash; surgical-graft logistics and Krystal's convenient VYJUVEK limit the ramp.

rows.name: Journey
rows.drug: Emrosi (minocycline MR 40mg) — oral antibiotic; derm portfolio
rows.cat: Emrosi commercial ramp
rows.pitch: Emrosi revenue is $9.0M (+84% YoY) in Q3 on ~40k scripts, and the $104M cap is 0.35x the $300M peak estimate; the ramp must outrun going-concern doubt and Oracea's formulary position.

rows.name: Fortress
rows.drug: Holding company: ZYCUBO (Menkes) + Journey Medical (derm) + royalties
rows.cat: MB-109 GBM trial start possible Q1 2027 (unconfirmed); FB-607 Ph2 topline 2H 2027; Triplex CMV timing unguided
rows.pitch: The $205M PRV sale (closed Mar 2026) and $152M cash against a $57M cap price ZYCUBO and Journey derm near zero; holding-company structure and 3.8 quarters of runway explain the discount.

rows.name: Incyte
rows.drug: Povorcitinib — oral selective JAK1 (+ Jakafi/Opzelura base)
rows.cat: Povorcitinib EU HS decision and PN Ph3 (STOP-PN1/2) Q4 2026; asthma Ph2 by YE; US HS approval Q1 2027
rows.pitch: Povorcitinib's 54-week HS data (up to 71.4% HiSCR50) and a Q1 2027 US launch are real, yet a $25B cap sits on ~$5.3B of guided net sales, so HS reads as incremental, not re-rating.

rows.name: Verrica
rows.cat: VP-315 Gorlin Ph3 design/funding decision undated; YCANTH COVE-2 common-warts topline Q1 2027 is a separate non-cancer item
rows.pitch: VP-315 cleared 51% of lesions completely on histology (n=93) in BCC Ph2; the Ph3 (possibly Gorlin) design is undecided and unfunded. A $68M cap is 17% of the $396M weighted peak, but $14M cash vs $12M debt makes dilution the gate.

rows.name: MediWound
rows.cat: VALUE Ph3 interim sample-size reassessment and enrollment completion, end Q1 2027
rows.pitch: The VALUE Ph3 (216 pts) is enrolling slower than planned, with the sample-size reassessment due end Q1 2027; a $176M cap vs a $450M weighted peak is cheap if EscharEx works, but cash is $28M.

rows.name: Evolus
rows.drug: Jeuveau (prabotulinumtoxinA) + Evolysse fillers + Profhilo (skin quality) + Estyme (EU launch)
rows.cat: Evolysse Sculpt FDA approval expected by year-end 2026
rows.pitch: Revenue grew 13% to $78.0M with $1.2M adj. EBITDA, FY guide $330-337M, and Sculpt approval due Q4; the $439M cap is 1.2x our $360M peak, but Botox's ~70% share caps the upside.

rows.name: Lineage Cell
rows.cat: GAlette Ph2a data (Genentech-sponsored): no company-guided timing
rows.pitch: OpRegen showed +6.2 ETDRS letters and RPE re-appearance at 36 months, but in n=5 uncontrolled; $202M cap is 1.5x weighted peak and the Ph2a has no guided data date, so patience is the call.

rows.name: Ocular
rows.drug: AXPAXLI (axitinib intravitreal hydrogel implant) — sustained anti-VEGF
rows.cat: AXPAXLI NDA submission (Q4 2026, not yet filed)
rows.pitch: AXPAXLI SOL-1 met its superiority-design primary (p=0.0006) and the pre-NDA meeting is done; at a $1.4B cap vs ~$2.9B weighted peak the stock is cheap against filing risk; SOL-R in 2028 is the durability test.

rows.name: 4DMT
rows.cat: 4FRONT-1 Ph3 topline (wet AMD vs aflibercept) expected Q2 2027; 4FRONT-2 topline 2H 2027
rows.pitch: 4D-150 cut aflibercept injections 78% over two years (n=45), and the $863M cap is 0.4x our $2.1B weighted peak; with $375M of cash and 6.7 quarters, financing could arrive before the 4FRONT-1 readout.

rows.name: Outlook Tx
rows.cat: US commercial launch execution / payer coverage & uptake
rows.pitch: LYTENAVA won approval in Jul 2026 with ~12-year exclusivity, but runway is about 1 quarter ($11M cash, $18M debt, $97M cap) and payers still have off-label Avastin, so we avoid.

rows.name: Kodiak
rows.stage: Phase 3 complete; multi-indication BLA planned Q4 2026
rows.cat: Zenkuda multi-indication BLA Q4 2026; KSI-101 PEAK Ph3 topline Dec 2026
rows.pitch: Ph3 wins in wet AMD (p=0.0007, 54% at 6-month dosing) and DR support a Q4 BLA, but only non-inferiority to aflibercept, KSI-101 PEAK binary in Dec, and $89M cash vs a $6.3B cap mean dilution risk.

rows.name: Oculis
rows.cat: R&D Day 12/8/26; privosegtor acute MS IND clearance Q4 2026; licaminlimab PREDICT-1 topline YE2026
rows.pitch: After OCS-01 failed Ph3 in DME, privosegtor has BTD, PRIME and ACUITY data (+18 letters LCVA); $282M cash is 60% of the $471M cap and no NAION drug is approved, so skew favors upside.

rows.name: Surrozen
rows.cat: DUET Ph1b topline data 2H 2027; Ph2a topline 2028
rows.pitch: SZN-8141 has dosed its first DME patient with no efficacy data, and Ph1b reads in 2H 2027 while AXPAXLI, DURAVYU, 4D-150 and Zenkuda advance; $616M cap is 4.4x weighted peak despite $100M cash.

rows.name: Belite
rows.stage: Filed (Stargardt NDA; geographic atrophy in Ph3)
rows.cat: FDA PDUFA action (Stargardt disease NDA, priority review)
rows.pitch: First-ever Stargardt candidate (36% lesion-growth cut, p=0.0033) has priority review and a Feb 12 2027 PDUFA, but $6.6B vs a $1.2B weighted peak means PHOENIX in geographic atrophy carries the value.

rows.name: Ocugen
rows.cat: liMeliGhT Ph3 topline Q1 2027; BLA submission after topline
rows.pitch: OCU400 liMeliGhT Ph3 (n=140) is fully enrolled with topline Q1 2027; a $261M cap vs ~$1.2B weighted peak is asymmetric, but $84M cash, $132M debt and 5 quarters of runway invite a raise.

rows.name: Opus Genetics
rows.drug: OPGx-LCA5 — one-time subretinal AAV gene augmentation (LCA5), lead program; OPGx-BEST1 — subretinal AAV2 BEST1 gene therapy (secondary asset, Ph1/2)
rows.indication: Leber Congenital Amaurosis 5 (LCA5-associated inherited retinal disease) — lead; OPGx-BEST1 targets BEST1-related Best disease — secondary
rows.cat: OPGx-BEST1 BIRD-1 topline Q1 2027; LCA5 Ph3 dosing starts Q4 2026
rows.pitch: LCA5 registrational Ph3 (8 pts) starts dosing Q4 2026 and BEST1 BIRD-1 reads Q1 2027; the $387M cap is 1.7x our $231M weighted peak with $89M cash against $35M of debt, so the balance is fair.

rows.name: SpyGlass
rows.drug: BIM-IOL System — bimatoprost drug-pads on an intraocular lens
rows.cat: BIM-IOL registrational Ph3 enrollment
rows.pitch: BIM-IOL's FIH shows 37% mean IOP reduction and 86% off drops at 4 years, yet it is small and Ph3s only finish enrolling in 2027; a $1.1B cap is 2.0x weighted peak, though $216M cash funds through 2028.

rows.name: Tarsus
rows.cat: TP-04 KORE (ocular rosacea) + TP-05 Calliope (Lyme prevention) Ph2 toplines 1H 2027
rows.pitch: XDEMVY sold $194.6M in Q3 (+64% y/y; $513.9M YTD, >$1B cumulative) and has no direct Demodex competitor; a $3.9B cap is ~5x annualized Q3 sales, with Ph2 pipeline toplines in 1H 2027.

rows.name: LENZ
rows.cat: Reorganization completion Q4 2026; interim CEO 12/1/26; ex-US approvals (Saudi, Malaysia, Vietnam) undated
rows.pitch: VIZZ sales hit $2.6M in Q3 (+~50% q/q) with >38,000 paid Rx, and $197M cash is 1.6x the $120M cap; the debate is cash-pay adoption plus an interim CEO and a marketing reorganization.

rows.name: Phathom
rows.cat: EoE Ph2 (pHalcon-EoE-201) 12-wk topline; FDA exclusivity docket comments due Nov 23
rows.pitch: Q3 VOQUEZNA sales $84.7M (+71% YoY), second straight positive operating cash flow quarter, guidance $310-325M; $499M cap is ~1.5x that, with EoE Ph2 topline and an exclusivity ruling due.

rows.name: Ardelyx
rows.indication: IBS with constipation (IBS-C); hyperphosphatemia in dialysis
rows.cat: ACCEL Ph3 (CIC) topline 2H27; IBSRELA guidance $350-370M
rows.pitch: IBSRELA grew 23% to $96.3M in Q3 but FY26 guidance was cut to $350-370M on payer friction; $823M cap is ~1.6x annualized revenue, and ACCEL Ph3 in CIC reads out 2H27.

rows.name: Ironwood
rows.drug: Apraglutide (weekly GLP-2) — SBS-IF; + Linzess (linaclotide) commercial base
rows.cat: STARS-2 confirmatory Ph3 (2028)
rows.pitch: FDA wanted a second Ph3 (STARS-2, 2028, filing 2029) after STARS hit; with $133M quarterly revenue but $325M debt, the $803M cap is ~1.9x our $420M weighted peak, little left unpriced.

rows.name: ARS
rows.cat: ARS-2 CSU Ph2b interim data (Q1 2027); neffy path to breakeven by YE2027
rows.pitch: Q2 neffy revenue $26.2M, ~5% share, but no new formulary wins; $361M cap is ~1.0x our $365M weighted peak, with $138M cash vs $197M debt and CSU Ph2b interim (Q1 2027) as the offset.

rows.name: DBV
rows.cat: FDA BLA filing acceptance and Priority Review decision
rows.pitch: VITESSE hit (46.6% vs 14.8%) and the BLA is in, yet $646M is 2.7x our $239M weighted peak and $166M cash covers 3.2 quarters, so dilution risk argues waiting for the filing decision.

rows.name: Aquestive
rows.cat: FDA PDUFA action on Anaphylm NDA resubmission, March 16 2027
rows.pitch: Resubmitted after a Jan CRL on human factors; PDUFA Mar 16 2027 at ~59% PoS. Yet $473M cap is 5.7x our $83M weighted peak, with $90M cash vs $51M debt and neffy ahead on the market.

rows.name: Pharvaris
rows.drug: Deucrictibant — oral bradykinin B2 antagonist (on-demand + prophylaxis)
rows.cat: Deucrictibant IR on-demand PDUFA Apr 23 2027; CREAATE Part 1 topline 1Q27; XR NDA 1H27
rows.pitch: On-demand NDA has an Apr 23 2027 PDUFA and prophylaxis cut attacks 83% (n=85), but $2.3B is 2.0x our $1.1B weighted peak, with $321M cash and KalVista's Ekterly already approved.

rows.name: BioCryst
rows.drug: ORLADEYO (berotralstat) — oral once-daily HAE prophylaxis (+ navenibart, long-acting injectable, in development)
rows.cat: ORLADEYO revenue growth (FY26 guide $625-645M); navenibart ALPHA-ORBIT Ph3 topline (both dosing arms) expected Q3 2027
rows.pitch: ORLADEYO guided to $625-645M for FY26 (~3x on the $1.9B cap) and $180M last quarter; navenibart Ph3 reads out Q3 2027. $375M cash against $817M debt and injectable/CRISPR rivals temper it.

rows.name: Intellia
rows.cat: FDA PDUFA decision on lonvo-z (HAE), priority review
rows.pitch: Ph3 HAELO hit and the BLA has priority review (PDUFA Mar 10 2027, no adcom): $1.4B cap is 0.4x our $3.6B weighted peak, though $615M cash must carry a launch vs monthly injectables.

rows.name: Celldex
rows.cat: BLA submission for barzolvolimab in CSU
rows.pitch: Two positive CSU Ph3s (n=1,939; CR 42-55% in omalizumab-refractory) and $650M cash fund the 2027 BLA; $2.2B cap is 1.2x our $1.8B peak, so the upside is share vs Novartis' remibrutinib.

rows.name: Septerna
rows.cat: SEP-479 Ph1 SAD/MAD data Q1 2027
rows.pitch: SEP-479 is in healthy-volunteer Ph1 with data Q1 2027 and its first PTH1R candidate was dropped; a $2.0B cap is 7x the $270M weighted peak, with $565M cash and a 70% 12-month run.

rows.name: Evommune
rows.drug: EVO301 — IL-18BP fusion protein (lead AD asset, Ph2a complete); EVO756 (oral MRGPRX2 antagonist) discontinued in AD (Sep 2026) and CSU (Jun 2026), continuing only in migraine prophylaxis Ph2b
rows.indication: Atopic dermatitis (via EVO301); EVO756 now migraine-prophylaxis only
rows.cat: EVO301 global Ph2b trial initiation (mid-2027)
rows.pitch: EVO756 missed all endpoints in AD (n=121) and CSU, leaving EVO301 (Ph2a n=70, EASI -55% vs -22%) with a Ph2b not until mid-2027. Cash of $262M props up a $304M cap, but runway is ~10 quarters and AD is crowded; the upside is not credible.

rows.name: First Tracks
rows.cat: ANB033 celiac Ph1b Cohort 2 mucosal-healing topline
rows.pitch: ANB033 beat placebo on VH:CrD (+0.49, p=0.009) in a small Ph1b, yet FB102 shares the target with Ph2 data a year earlier; $2.0B cap vs $156M cash and 5.7 quarters of runway looks stretched.

rows.name: Agomab
rows.cat: NOV-ERA Ph2b enrollment progress; Wk24 passability readout not yet guided
rows.pitch: Market cap $294M vs $288M cash (16.9 quarters runway) buys an oral GI-restricted ALK5 inhibitor entering ~320-pt Ph2b with FDA Fast Track; efficacy in strictures is unproven and no readout is guided.

rows.name: Shattuck Labs
rows.drug: SL-325 — first-in-class DR3 antagonist (blocks the TL1A receptor)
rows.cat: RECEPTIVE-CD1 Ph2b 12-week induction data
rows.pitch: SL-325 is a DR3 antagonist chasing TL1A with Merck's tulisokibart in late Ph3; Ph2b Crohn's data not until 1H 2028, and the stock has more than doubled in a year to $854M vs $196M cash.

rows.name: Eupraxia
rows.cat: RESOLVE Ph2b interim analysis (placebo-controlled portion)
rows.pitch: RESOLVE Ph2b is fully enrolled (120 pts vs placebo) with interim data in Dec; Ph1b/2a showed 66% remission at 36 weeks, but open-label and a $565M cap near ~1.7x weighted peak leave little cushion.

rows.name: Abivax
rows.cat: Obefazimod UC NDA submission
rows.pitch: Obefazimod's 39.3% placebo-adjusted maintenance remission tops oral UC peers and the NDA is due by end-2026; at $6.7B vs ~$5.9B weighted peak, the debate is launch share, not efficacy.

rows.name: Spyre
rows.cat: SKYLINE Part B induction topline (monotherapy and combination arms), Q3 2027
rows.pitch: SKYLINE Part A hit for SPY001, SPY002 and SPY003, yet it was open-label and differentiation is convenience; at $9.4B vs $1.1B cash, Part B randomized topline (Q3 2027) must justify ~4.8x weighted peak.

rows.name: Odyssey
rows.cat: Randomized Ph2b monotherapy + Ph2a vedolizumab-combo topline induction data
rows.pitch: OD-001 posted 27% remission (20 mg BID, n=41) and 61% response with no SAEs, but no placebo arm; cap is ~2.4x cash and randomized Ph2b data are not due until 2H 2027.

rows.name: Palisade
rows.cat: ASCENTRA-UC Ph2b 12-week induction topline, Q4 2027
rows.pitch: Gut-restricted PDE4 PALI-2108 has cash ($114M, 14.6 quarters) to reach the Q4 2027 Ph2b readout in ~204 UC pts; the cap is ~0.5x weighted peak, though the signal so far is n=5 open-label.

rows.name: Equillium
rows.cat: EQ504 Ph1 SAD/MAD proof-of-mechanism data
rows.pitch: EQ504 only began Ph1 SAD/MAD in healthy volunteers on Oct 26, with proof-of-mechanism data Q2 2027; $53M cash is 41% of the $129M cap and the UC field is crowded with approved agents.

rows.name: Viridian
rows.cat: VRDN-008 Ph1 healthy-volunteer data Q4 2026; elegrobart BLA submission Q1 2027
rows.pitch: Approved LUMVOA did $24.7M in its first quarter and elegrobart (SC) files Q1 2027, with $955M cash against $364M debt; the $3.7B cap is 1.8x the $2.1B peak estimate, so convenience over Tepezza must carry it.

rows.name: MannKind
rows.drug: Afrezza (inhaled insulin) + FUROSCIX (subQ furosemide, acquired via scPharma Oct 2025) + Tyvaso DPI royalties
rows.indication: Type 1/2 diabetes (Afrezza, incl. new pediatric label); edema in heart failure/CKD (FUROSCIX); + inhaled-drug royalties
rows.cat: Ralinepag DPI development by United Therapeutics; MannKind expects $15M milestones in 2027
rows.pitch: Q3 revenue grew 24% to $101.9M (Afrezza $19.3M, Furoscix $22.4M, ReadyFlow ~75% of shipments), yet $567M debt vs $97M cash and a $1.3B cap resting on royalties leave little room until Afrezza pediatric uptake shows.

rows.name: Sana
rows.cat: SC451 IND filing/clearance and Ph1/2 start (as early as 2026)
rows.pitch: The 14-month UP421 result is one patient with donor islets, not SC451; a $577M cap is 1.8x the $325M weighted peak, Vertex is far ahead, and $122M cash runs only to mid-2027, implying financing before 2027 data.

rows.name: Century
rows.cat: CNTY-813 IND submission (Q4 2026, imminent)
rows.pitch: An IND is a paper milestone: CNTY-813 has no human data until 2H 2027 while Vertex is dosing and SANA files on a similar timeline, so a $338M cap is 3.2x the $106M weighted peak even with $174M of cash.

rows.name: vTv
rows.cat: CATT1 Ph3 topline expected mid-2027
rows.pitch: CATT1 is fully enrolled with 166 randomized and topline mid-2027; a $220M cap is ~0.2x the $1.1B weighted peak (45% PoS x $2.4B), cash of $77M runs 18.6 quarters, so the readout is a binary with asymmetric payoff.

rows.name: SAB
rows.indication: New-onset (Stage 3) type 1 diabetes + established T1D (via new PRISE-hATG study)
rows.cat: SAFEGUARD full enrollment (pediatric cohort) Q4 2026; topline 2H 2027; PRISE-hATG first patient dosed Q4 2026
rows.pitch: Only four treated patients in Ph1, yet 3 of 4 preserved C-peptide and the registrational Ph2b has Fast Track; $622M cap is ~0.8x the $822M weighted peak, and $205M cash runs through 2028 past the 2H 2027 topline.

rows.name: MeiraGTx
rows.drug: Bota-vec (botaretigene sparoparvovec) -- AAV gene therapy; now wholly owned by MeiraGTx after re-acquiring global rights from Johnson & Johnson (Apr 2026) (+ AAV2-hAQP1 for xerostomia)
rows.cat: EMA MAA submission for bota-vec Dec 2026; FDA BLA submission Q1 2027
rows.pitch: Bota-vec re-acquired from J&J; EMA MAA Dec 2026, BLA Q1 2027, with $187M cash against $122M debt. A cap 3.7x the ~$229M weighted peak leaves little room, so we wait for the filings.

rows.name: Maze
rows.cat: HORIZON Ph2 final data early 2027; pivotal AMKD trial start 1H 2027
rows.pitch: MZE829 hit -35.6% mean uACR (FSGS -61.8% vs inaxaplin ~43%), open-label n=12-15; but a $2.0B cap is 4.7x our $430M weighted peak, so watch final data early 2027 and pivotal start.

rows.name: Travere
rows.cat: Civorebrutinib US IND by YE26; CEO transition Dec 1; HARMONY Ph3 topline 2H 2027
rows.pitch: FILSPARI grew 120% to $200.2M in Q3 with 1,932 new starts and FSGS now approved, yet a $4.8B cap is 3.7x the $1.3B peak estimate against Tarpeyo, Fabhalta and newcomers; HARMONY Ph3 in 2H 2027.

rows.name: Vera
rows.cat: FDA decision on sBLA for full approval expected mid-2027 (no PDUFA date yet); EMA MAA submission Q1 2027
rows.pitch: Accelerated approval Jul 2026, then final ORIGIN 3 data (HR 0.24, eGFR -0.1 vs -5.7); full-approval sBLA filed Nov 3 for mid-2027. ~$1.9B cap vs $384M cash, 3.8 quarters, against Fabhalta, Filspari and Vertex's povetacicept.

rows.name: Jade
rows.cat: EVERGREEN Ph3 start Q4 2026; JUNIPER Ph2 interim data Q2 2027
rows.pitch: JADE101 shows ~70% IgA reduction in 32 healthy volunteers, but no patient data until JUNIPER interim in Q2 2027 and atacicept is approved; $1.3B cap is 4.9x the $264M weighted peak despite $476M cash.

rows.name: Aurinia
rows.indication: Lupus nephritis (LUPKYNIS, approved/commercial); autoimmune hepatitis (zetomipzomib, primary pipeline focus, Ph2a PORTOLA); broad autoimmune indications (aritinercept, BAFF/APRIL dual inhibitor, in clinical development for 3 indications)
rows.cat: FY2026 results vs raised $325-330M revenue guide; PRESERVE Ph4 and aritinercept programs ongoing (no dated milestone guided)
rows.pitch: Q3 LUPKYNIS sales of $79.4M and a raised $325-330M guide are solid, with $487M cash, yet a $2.1B cap is over 6x revenue and 3.2x the $650M peak estimate; zetomipzomib is early, so the stock is balanced.

rows.name: Nkarta
rows.indication: Idiopathic inflammatory myopathy (myositis) and systemic sclerosis (lead indications, early efficacy signal flagged by company); plus ANCA-associated vasculitis, rheumatoid arthritis, lupus nephritis, and primary membranous nephropathy (6 total indications in Ntrust-1/2)
rows.cat: FDA registrational-path discussions; more myositis/SSc follow-up and registrational dose plan 1H 2027
rows.pitch: Myositis 5/6 and SSc 5/7 responses are early and small; the $93M cap is 0.4x its $216M cash, but 7.9 quarters of runway and CAR-T rivals like Adicet's prula-cel mean cash alone is not the case.

rows.name: Eloxx
rows.cat: EXACT Ph2b 16-week placebo-controlled topline (filtration slit density), mid-2027
rows.pitch: Readthrough agent with n=3 Alport biopsy responses; the $146M cap is fairly priced against 0.4x cash, funded into 2028, and the 24-patient EXACT Ph2b 16-week topline (mid-2027) is the real test.

rows.name: Climb
rows.indication: Primary membranous nephropathy (+ SLE, IgA nephropathy)
rows.cat: Additional PrisMN Ph2 data (1000 mg cohort, longer follow-up) in 2027; CLYM116 IgAN NAVIGATE-2 data 1H 2027
rows.pitch: At 200 mg, 70% mean PLA2R reduction and 5/13 remissions are promising, yet open-label, small and uncontrolled against rituximab; $788M cap is ~6x the $130M weighted peak, so wait for the 1000 mg cohort in 2027.

rows.name: Generate
rows.cat: SOLAIRIA-1/2 Ph3 enrolling (33 of 42 planned countries approved); next catalyst is Ph3 topline readout (timing TBD)
rows.pitch: Golukibart has Ph1 biomarker data (n=96) but no exacerbation data; Ph3 SOLAIRIA-1/2 topline 2H 2027. $1.4B cap is ~1.9x our $700M weighted peak, with $404M cash and Tezspire approved as the bar.

rows.name: Upstream
rows.cat: Ph3 starts in severe asthma and CRSwNP planned Q1 2027; COPD Ph2 VENTURE data 2H 2027; cash $207M funds through 2027
rows.pitch: Ph2 VALIANT (n=478) cut exacerbations 56% at 100 mg q12w (p<0.001), yet the cap is $119M vs $207M cash. Cash only funds through 2027, so the ~1,500-patient Ph3 starting Q1 2027 needs a raise or partner.

rows.name: aTyr
rows.cat: Partnering/licensing to fund Ph3 (no date guided); EFZO-CONNECT SSc-ILD Ph2 full results Q2 2027
rows.pitch: Ph3 EFZO-FIT missed (p=0.33); the new FVC-primary Ph3 rests on a 44-patient post-hoc subgroup and depends on a licensee. $514M cap vs $50M cash after a ~530% 12-month run.

rows.name: Dianthus
rows.cat: MoMeNtum (MMN) Ph2 topline Dec 2026; CAPTIVATE Part A YE27, Part B YE28; EMERGE gMG topline 2H28
rows.pitch: $5.1B cap is ~2.1x our $2.5B weighted peak on Ph2 gMG data alone; EMERGE Ph3 reads 2H 2028, MMN Ph2 topline Dec 2026. $1.2B cash covers 32 quarters, but gMG has argenx, UCB and Alexion in place.

rows.name: Annexon
rows.cat: US BLA submission (tanruprubart, GBS) guided Q4 2026
rows.pitch: Single-infusion tanruprubart improved EQ-VAS at week 1 (p=0.0089) in Ph3 n=241; EU MAA is under review and the US BLA is guided Q4 2026. $788M cap vs $213M cash, 4.4 quarters; IVIG generics are SoC.

rows.name: Cartesian
rows.cat: AURORA Ph3 gMG topline
rows.pitch: AURORA Ph3 gMG topline Q1 2027 on an SPA-agreed design; $208M cap vs $123M cash (5.2 quarters) is ~15% of the $1.4B weighted peak. Retreatment gave -6.6 MG-ADL at month 12, but only 5 patients.

rows.name: Vor
rows.drug: Telitacicept — dual BAFF/APRIL fusion (in-licensed from RemeGen)
rows.cat: UPSTREAM MG Ph3 topline data (24-wk primary endpoint)
rows.pitch: UPSTREAM MG topline (24-wk, Jun 2027) decides it: China data show -7.5 MG-ADL at wk 48, but global replication is unproven and efgartigimod and zilucoplan are already approved; cap $1.8B, cash $482M.

rows.name: TG
rows.cat: SubQ BRIUMVI Ph3 topline (around YE2026 or early 2027); potential SubQ launch 2028
rows.pitch: Q3 US BRIUMVI revenue $232.6M (+52%) and FY26 guidance raised to ~$1B, but $8.8B is ~9.7x our $910M peak estimate. SubQ Ph3 topline lands YE2026/early 2027 as ocrelizumab biosimilars enter.

rows.name: Immunic
rows.indication: Relapsing multiple sclerosis (lead); progressive MS (Phase 3 planned to initiate later in 2026, built on Ph2 CALLIPER data)
rows.cat: ENSURE-1/2 Ph3 topline (relapsing MS) expected December 2026; NDA mid-2027 if positive
rows.pitch: Both relapsing-MS Ph3s (1,121 and 1,100 pts) are fully enrolled with futility passed; topline Dec 2026, NDA mid-2027 if positive. $307M cap vs $132M cash, 4.4 quarters, against ocrelizumab and ofatumumab.

rows.name: Tiziana
rows.cat: Full INFORM-MS analysis at a scientific congress and FDA meeting on na-SPMS development path (no dates guided)
rows.pitch: Foralumab met its microglial PET primary at 50 ug only (n=48, EDSS unchanged), and with $1M of cash against an $85M cap the FDA meeting matters less than the next financing.

rows.name: Cogent
rows.cat: Sequential PDUFAs: GIST (Nov 30, 2026), NonAdvSM (Dec 30, 2026), AdvSM (Jun 29, 2027)
rows.pitch: GIST PDUFA Nov 30, NonAdvSM Dec 30, AdvSM Jun 2027 after three positive Ph3s (SUMMIT p=0.0002); a $5.2B cap already assumes a successful launch against Sanofi's Ayvakit.

rows.name: Hutchmed
rows.cat: Sovleplenib NMPA (wAIHA/ITP) decisions
rows.pitch: NMPA decisions on wAIHA (Ph3 durable Hb response 66.0%) and ITP are due by year-end, yet $2.6B cap is ~4.3x our weighted peak and a China-only footprint with no US filing limits the read-through.

rows.name: Lakefront
rows.drug: Gamgertamig (OM336) — BCMA × CD3 bispecific T-cell engager
rows.cat: ASH poster Dec 13 2026: gamgertamig Ph1b ITP/AIHA data; investor webcast Dec 14; registrational studies 2027
rows.pitch: Cap of $2.3B is 0.9x the $2.5B cash; early Ph1b data (ITP 18/20, AIHA 9/9 responders, grade 1 CRS in 18%) are strong but short follow-up; ASH poster Dec 13 is the next test.

rows.name: Kiniksa
rows.cat: KPL-1161 Ph1 start by end 2026; KPL-387 Ph3 PASTORALE data 2H 2027
rows.pitch: Q3 ARCALYST revenue of $286.0M (+58%) and a raised $1.045-1.050B guide are excellent, yet an $8.0B cap is ~7.6x guidance, and Cardiol's Ph3 plus KPL-387 timing (2H27) cap the multiple.

rows.name: Cardiol
rows.cat: MAVERIC topline guided 12-18 months from Aug 2026 (Aug 2027-Feb 2028); enrollment completes end Q4 2026
rows.pitch: Pivotal withdrawal-design MAVERIC (enrollment up to 150 pts, done end Q4 2026) reads Aug 2027-Feb 2028; cap is 0.4x weighted peak, yet $29M cash needs funding and ARCALYST sets the bar.

rows.name: Mirum
rows.drug: Volixibat — oral IBAT inhibitor (+ LIVMARLI/CHENODAL commercial)
rows.cat: Brelovitug HDV topline Q4 2026 (AZURE-4 per PR); volixibat PSC NDA H1 27; VANTAGE Q1 27
rows.pitch: With FY26 guidance of $715-720M, $6.0B is ~8.4x sales and $731M debt sits against $501M cash; FDA wants a new PSC Ph3, so brelovitug HDV topline in Q4 carries the near-term upside.

rows.name: ProQR
rows.cat: Dec 2026 full AX-0810 Ph1 dataset; early Jan 2027 AX-0811 data; mid-2027 Ph2 start
rows.pitch: First clinical validation of Axiomer RNA editing (dose-dependent bile acid changes in healthy volunteers) is real, but no patient efficacy until the mid-2027 Ph2; cash is 71% of the $169M cap.

rows.name: Roivant
rows.drug: Immunovant stake (IMVT-1402, anti-FcRn) + Priovant's brepocitinib (TYK2/JAK1 inhibitor) + other 'vants' + $4.3B cash
rows.indication: Graves' disease (via Immunovant) + a diversified vant portfolio
rows.cat: IMVT-1402 Graves' and MG potentially registrational readouts; LISRAYA launch ramp
rows.pitch: Cap of $28.0B is ~12x the 55% x $4.2B weighted peak despite $4.2B cash and LISRAYA's Aug 27 approval; Immunovant's two TED Ph3s failed and the CLE Ph2 missed, leaving Graves' and MG in 2027.

rows.name: Cabaletta
rows.cat: RESET-Myositis registrational topline 2H 2027; myositis BLA submission 1Q 2028
rows.pitch: The market ascribes less than cash to a CAR-T with durable drug-free myositis responses (5/6 at 16 wks, all maintained); $299M vs $188M cap, topline 2H27, BLA 1Q28, but runway is only 7.1 quarters.

rows.name: ADMA
rows.cat: FY2026 revenue vs guidance; capacity expansion
rows.pitch: Q3 revenue grew only 5% to $141.1M as ASCENIV rose 31% and BIVIGAM slid to $15.4M; guidance of at least $530M puts the $3.0B cap near 5.6x, so the next print needs to hold margins (71%).

rows.name: Pharming
rows.cat: Joenja lower-dose pediatric (13-27kg) sNDA PDUFA
rows.pitch: Joenja grew 58% YoY to $23.8M in Q3, but FY26 revenue guidance was cut and the CEO left Sep 29. With the share count corrected the cap is ~$0.86B, ~2.7x the $318M weighted peak (86.5% x $368M); the Jan 30 2027 pediatric PDUFA is the catalyst.

rows.name: Prime
rows.drug: PM577a — in vivo Prime Editor (corrects ATP7B in Wilson's)
rows.indication: Wilson disease (H1069Q ATP7B mutation, ~30-50% of WD patients) + prime-editing platform
rows.cat: PM577a Wilson Ph1/2 initial data (2027); funded through 2027 after $143.7M Nov 2026 raise
rows.pitch: PM577a, a one-time Wilson's fix, dosed its first patient Oct 5 with data in 2027; a $760M cap is 0.8x the $912M weighted peak, and the $143.7M Nov raise funds it through 2027, so it is a wait for data.

rows.name: Mesoblast
rows.cat: Rexlemestrocel-L LVAD BLA filing (FDA-aligned, no date); CLBP Ph3 12-mo readout 2027; Ryoncil ramp
rows.pitch: Ryoncil FY2026 net revenue of $115.2M (net loss $57.5M) is real, but a $1.6B cap is ~14x sales and ~1.8x our $900M peak. Revascor LVAD BLA and the mid-2027 low-back-pain Ph3 readout are the swing factors; MSC efficacy remains contested.

rows.name: Eledon
rows.cat: Ph3 kidney-transplant initiation
rows.pitch: Zero biopsy-proven rejections after month 6 and eGFR 71 vs 58 are strong, yet LEGACY (~600 pts) needs funding: cash $70M, 3.3 quarters of runway, against a $238M cap.

rows.name: Q32
rows.cat: Q4 2026 regulatory discussions; start of registration-directed AA program 1H 2027
rows.pitch: Wk36 SALT reduction of 35.3% (open-label, n=33) was maintained off-drug, and the market ascribes ~$9M to bempikibart; the 15% PoS reflects that placebo-controlled proof is still missing.

rows.name: Kymera
rows.cat: BROADEN2 Ph2b topline data (imminent, year-end 2026, accelerated 6 months)
rows.pitch: BROADEN2 Ph2b (~200 AD patients, 16 weeks, 3 doses) reads by year-end; with $1.6B cash against a $13B cap, the stock needs a clean dupilumab-class result, and misses are not covered.

rows.name: Nektar
rows.cat: Ph3 ZENITH alopecia areata trial start (December 2026); first Ph3 AD topline mid-2028
rows.pitch: REZPEG hit its Ph2b (n=393, p<0.001, Lancet) with durable maintenance, and ~$300M of implied pipeline value is modest; the cost is a long wait for Ph3 topline in mid-2028 against dupilumab.

rows.name: Aclaris
rows.indication: Eosinophilic esophagitis (Ph2b); atopic dermatitis and asthma under assessment
rows.cat: ATI-052 Ph2b trial start in eosinophilic esophagitis (Q1 2027)
rows.pitch: After bosakitug missed in AD on Nov 16, ATI-052 (Ph1b: AD EASI -45% placebo-adjusted, asthma FeNO -59%) carries the company; EoE Ph2b starts Q1 2027. A $565M cap is 2.8x cash and ~2.8x our $200M weighted peak, so we wait for Ph2b data.

rows.name: Turn
rows.drug: GX-03 — topical small-molecule IL-36/IL-31/IL-4 pathway inhibitor (first-in-class, non-systemic)
rows.indication: Atopic dermatitis (moderate-to-severe), lead indication; pipeline expansion into onychomycosis and hidradenitis suppurativa
rows.cat: GX-03 Ph2 AD topline (Q1 2027)
rows.pitch: Interim EASI-90 of 44.4% vs 30.4% (n=50) was encouraging, but the Stage-2 expansion to ~120-135 patients raises the bar, and the cash position forces dilution risk before or after data.
