rows.name: Moonlake
rows.cat: FDA acceptance of HS BLA (~60 days post submission) and PDUFA date assignment; PsA filing planning
rows.pitch: With the HS BLA submitted Sep 30 and teen data accepted as pivotal, $1.0B vs $1.6B of weighted peak is asymmetric, but $499M cash vs $100M debt and no head-to-head win over bimekizumab cap the upside.

rows.name: Zura
rows.cat: TibuSHIELD Ph2 HS topline data (imminent, Q4 2026)
rows.pitch: Cash is ~1.4x the $136M cap with TibuSHIELD topline due Dec 15; the bar is bimekizumab in HS, but the runway of 9.5 quarters means a miss costs little relative to the cash backing.

rows.name: InflaRx
rows.indication: ANCA-associated vasculitis (renal AAV); HS partnership possible
rows.cat: AAV Ph2 site initiation early 2027; China PK bridging data 1H 2027
rows.pitch: Izicopan has only Ph1 safety/PK/PD and a 4-week HS/CSU Ph2a signal, with the ~35-per-arm renal AAV Ph2 starting early 2027. With a $174M cap against $179M cash, the market ascribes little to a ~12% PoS asset, so option value is cheap.

rows.name: Avalo
rows.cat: FDA feedback on abdakibart HS Ph3 plan by YE 2026; Ph3 program start 1H 2027
rows.pitch: LOTUS (n=253) hit at both doses, HiSCR75 42.2%/42.9% vs 25.6% placebo, yet the stock is -35% in a month and trades below its $463M cash. FDA feedback on the Ph3 plan is due by YE 2026; bimekizumab's ~49-50% is the bar to clear.

rows.name: Alumis
rows.cat: NDA submission for envudeucitinib in plaque psoriasis
rows.pitch: Two positive Ph3s (PASI90 68.0%/62.1% at wk24 vs apremilast) and a Q4 2026 NDA sit behind a $665M cap, ~0.5x our $1.4B weighted peak, after the Sep 1 SLE miss cut the stock 57%. Sotyktu is the bar and there is no head-to-head; cash is $431M.

rows.name: Arcutis
rows.indication: Plaque psoriasis; atopic dermatitis; seborrheic dermatitis
rows.cat: Infant-AD PDUFA; continued ZORYVE ramp
rows.pitch: Q3 ZORYVE revenue of $143.9M (+45% YoY, +11% QoQ) and guidance of $535-545M are strong, but a $3.4B cap is ~6x guidance and ~3x our $1.1B peak. Infant AD PDUFA Feb 23 2027 is expected; generics and Opzelura cap pricing.

rows.name: Oruka
rows.cat: EVERLAST-A 52-wk data (Dec 2026); ORCA-SURGE Ph2 wk16 data 1Q27; ORKA-001 Ph3 start 1H27
rows.pitch: EVERLAST-A shows PASI90 87.3% off-drug, and cash of $1.2B funds through BLA, yet $8.2B already assumes durability holds; Dec 52-week data are the test against approved IL-23s.

rows.name: XBiotech
rows.cat: V-SPINE Ph2 (axSpA) enrollment/first data
rows.pitch: A $56M cap vs $105M cash is a discount for a reason: vilamakitug has zero clinical efficacy data in axSpA, trails approved IL-17 agents, and the 150-pt V-SPINE Ph2 is the only test.

rows.name: Cue
rows.stage: Phase 2 (CSU topline reported; advancing toward Ph2b/3)
rows.cat: Initiation of global Ph2b/3 CSU trial and/or Phase 2 food allergy trial for CUE-221, building on the positive Sep 2026 CSU topline
rows.pitch: CUE-221 CSU Ph2 still reads well (78% complete response at 4 mg/kg in high-IgE pts), but the stock fell 80% on Nov 17 with no clinical news; until the Ascendant top-up share count is confirmed, the $44M cap and LONG call are unreliable.

rows.name: Zenas
rows.drug: Obexelimab — bifunctional CD19 × FcγRIIb B-cell inhibitor
rows.cat: SunStone SLE Ph2 topline Q4 2026; obexelimab IgG4-RD PDUFA 5/27/27
rows.pitch: INDIGO cut flare risk 56% (HR 0.44, p=0.0005) and the BLA is accepted; yet $1.9B cap vs $647M cash and $399M debt leans on IgG4-RD (modest) plus the unproven SLE Ph2 topline due Q4 2026.

rows.name: Fate
rows.cat: RECLAIM-LN enrollment and further FT819 SLE/LN data updates; no dated readout guided
rows.pitch: The market ascribes ~$20M ($159M cap less $139M cash) to FT819, now in the potentially registrational RECLAIM-LN trial; the catch is Kyverna's lead and ~5 quarters of runway.

rows.name: Immunovant
rows.indication: Graves' disease; MG; CIDP; Sjogren's; D2T RA (cutaneous lupus discontinued after Ph2 miss)
rows.cat: FDA discussions on D2T RA path by YE2026; Graves' and MG registrational toplines 2027
rows.pitch: D2T RA Ph2 hit at 600 mg (ACR20 92.5% vs 75.6%) but 300 mg did not separate, lupus Ph2b missed, Vyvgart leads; $6.9B is 3.3x our $2.1B weighted peak, so wait for 2027 Ph3s.

rows.name: AnaptysBio
rows.cat: Imsidolimab GPP PDUFA Dec 12 2026; GSK/Tesaro litigation judgment Q4 2026-Q1 2027; Jemperli royalty growth
rows.pitch: Jemperli net sales hit $365M (+20% YoY) and rectal cancer was approved in Oct, so the $1.4B cap sits well under our $1.5B peak estimate; Tesaro royalty litigation and $257M debt vs $164M cash are the risks.

rows.name: Artiva
rows.indication: Refractory rheumatoid arthritis; SLE, SSc, Sjögren's
rows.cat: Strategic alternatives review (merger, asset sale/license, or dissolution); no timing guided
rows.pitch: After the Oct 27 AlloNK discontinuation and strategic review (no timing guided), cash is ~1.6x the $202M cap; value hinges on the outcome and burn, not on any clinical event.

rows.name: Kyverna
rows.indication: Stiff-person syndrome (SPS); also gMG, non-active secondary progressive MS
rows.cat: FDA acceptance of miv-cel SPS BLA / priority review; potential approval and launch in 2027
rows.pitch: SPS BLA completed Nov 12 with priority review sought; KYSA-8 (n=26) showed 49% T25FW gain and 92% off chronic therapy. $301M cap vs $171M cash; no approved SPS drug, but runway is 4.4 quarters.

rows.name: Innoviva
rows.drug: GSK respiratory royalties (BREO/ANORO) + hospital anti-infectives (XACDURO, GIAPREZA, XERAVA, ZEVTERA) + Armata equity stake
rows.indication: GSK inhaler royalties + hospital anti-infective portfolio
rows.cat: GSK royalty streams; XACDURO ex-US licensing
rows.pitch: Q3 revenue $106.1M: GSK royalties $58.1M plus $43.3M US product sales (+45%, on track for $150M+ in 2026); the $1.3B cap vs $581M cash hinges on royalty duration and holding-co discount.

rows.name: Armata
rows.cat: FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation granted; Phase 3 protocol finalization and first dosing
rows.pitch: Breakthrough designation (Sep 14) and an FDA-aligned Ph3 superiority design are real, yet $18M cash vs $222M debt and ~2.7 quarters of runway make a raise a precondition to dosing.

rows.name: Spero
rows.drug: SP001 (IBI355) — anti-CD40L antibody, licensed from Innovent
rows.cat: SP001 Phase 2 initiation in IgG4-RD (Q2 2027)
rows.pitch: Cash of $108M is ~2x the $55M cap, with $103M debt netting that to ~$5M; UTEBZI is approved (GSK-run, $25M milestone received) and SP001 Ph2 in IgG4-RD starts ~Q2 2027.

rows.name: PolyPid
rows.cat: PDUFA decision (Nov 28, 2026, imminent)
rows.pitch: With approval at 90% PoS in our model and Azurity prepping an early 2027 launch, $130M vs $400M peak is the upside; the offset is just $16M cash (~2.7 quarters), so financing follows the PDUFA.

rows.name: CorMedix
rows.drug: DefenCath (taurolidine/heparin catheter-lock) + acquired Melinta Therapeutics hospital anti-infective portfolio + REZZAYO (rezafungin)
rows.cat: REZZAYO sNDA FDA action Q1 2027 (Priority Review); Heron acquisition close Q1 2027; 2027 guidance early 2027
rows.pitch: Q2'26 revenue was $101.9M (DefenCath $66.1M, Melinta $35.8M) vs a $383M cap and $355M cash; REZZAYO sNDA action in Q1 2027 adds a catalyst, while DefenCath concentration and $145M debt cap the re-rating.

rows.name: Valneva
rows.drug: Lyme vaccine (VLA15, Pfizer-partnered) + IXIARO/DUKORAL travel vaccines
rows.cat: Regulatory decisions on Pfizer/Valneva Lyme vaccine guided within 12 months of Aug 2026 (EMA review underway)
rows.pitch: VALOR's lower CI bound dipped just below the 20% threshold, yet EMA validated the MAA (Aug 2026) and Pfizer is aligning the FDA path; $536M cap vs $141M cash and $244M debt already reflects a decent outcome.

rows.name: SIGA
rows.cat: New US government TPOXX contract award (timing uncertain); pediatric Ph1 results by YE2026; Canada deliveries start 2027
rows.pitch: Approved smallpox franchise with $116M cash against a $205M cap; BARDA 19C is complete, Canada adds up to ~$15M, so the timing of a new US contract is the whole story.

rows.name: Vir
rows.drug: Tobevibart + elebsiran — anti-HDV mAb + siRNA combo
rows.cat: ECLIPSE 2 and ECLIPSE 3 Ph3 data Q1 2027; FDA submission mid-2027
rows.pitch: Ph3 ECLIPSE 1 (n=124) hit 44% vs 0% on undetectable HDV RNA with ALT normalization; $898M cash is 58% of a $1.5B cap, ECLIPSE 2/3 data Q1 2027, FDA filing mid-2027, one Grade 3 related AE.

rows.name: Arbutus
rows.drug: Imdusiran (AB-729, HBV siRNA) + Moderna/Genevant LNP-patent settlement
rows.cat: Federal Circuit ruling on 28 USC 1498 (gates up to $1.3B contingent Moderna payment); argued Nov 5 2026, no date
rows.pitch: Moderna has paid $950M (Arbutus share $178.4M) and up to $1.3B more hinges on the 28 USC 1498 ruling, argued Nov 5 with no date; imdusiran's 8 functional cures sit in an enriched subset of a crowded field.

rows.name: Atea
rows.cat: C-FORWARD Ph3 HCV topline (early 2027); NDA submission targeted mid-2027
rows.pitch: C-BEYOND matched Epclusa on SVR24 (93.9% vs 94.8%), and 8 weeks sufficed in non-cirrhotic patients; $191M cash is 58% of a $331M cap. C-FORWARD topline early 2027 sets up a mid-2027 NDA.

rows.name: Precision
rows.drug: PBGENE-HBV — in vivo gene editing (targets cccDNA)
rows.cat: PBGENE-DMD initial safety data targeted year-end 2026; ELIMINATE-B dose selection for Ph2 expansion
rows.pitch: First paired-biopsy evidence of cccDNA inactivation, 47-69% HBsAg cuts and no DLTs through 0.8 mg/kg, yet $215M cap is 2x the ~$109M weighted peak against $82M cash.

rows.name: Vaxcyte
rows.cat: OPUS-2 and OPUS-3 Ph3 topline (1H 2027); infant Ph2 data by end 1H 2027
rows.pitch: OPUS-1 hit non-inferiority on 28 shared serotypes and superiority on 3 unique, but 3 and 12F cleared only the historical bar vs PCV21; $9.9B cap is 2.1x the $4.7B weighted peak, BLA 1H 2028.

rows.name: Novavax
rows.cat: $75M Sanofi milestone on Nuvaxovid tech transfer completion (mid-2027); US CIC Ph3 start 2027
rows.pitch: Pivot to Matrix-M royalties (high-teens to low-20s % from Sanofi, Pfizer license) has worked, but a $1.3B cap is ~3.9x the $338M weighted peak; $75M Sanofi milestone due mid-2027.

rows.name: Enanta
rows.cat: LOTUS pediatric Ph2b topline 1Q 2027; RESOLVE Ph2b topline in 2027
rows.pitch: Zelicapavir cut hospitalization to 1.7% vs 5.0% and symptoms 6.7 days faster in a high-risk Ph2b subset; cap less cash is ~$116M while RESOLVE dosing starts and LOTUS reads 1Q 2027.

rows.name: Invivyd
rows.cat: DECLARATION Ph3 interim analysis (nAb titers, PK, safety) imminent per Nov 16 2026 PR; BLA to follow
rows.pitch: LIBERTY was positive (n=210) and the DECLARATION interim is imminent, but it reports titers, PK and safety, not efficacy; $126M cash is 79% of the $160M cap with ~3.2 quarters of runway.

rows.name: Precigen
rows.cat: R&D Day with PRGN-2009 Ph2 data and AdenoVerse update (undated); EMA Papzimeos MAA review
rows.pitch: Approved, cash-flow positive and profitable at $35.8M in Q3 on $72.9M revenue (+37% QoQ); a $1.7B cap is under the $1.8B peak estimate, with thin $51M cash and EMA review the swing factors.

rows.name: Assembly
rows.drug: GS-1179 / GS-5366 (formerly ABI-1179/ABI-5366) -- long-acting HSV helicase-primase inhibitors, exclusively licensed to Gilead
rows.cat: Gilead GS-1179 Phase 2 start in recurrent genital herpes by end 2026
rows.pitch: Assembly holds a 40% US cost/profit share and just received a $75M Gilead fee; ~$150M of implied value ($464M cap, $314M cash) awaits Gilead's Ph2 start by end 2026 and Ph2 data.

rows.name: Inovio
rows.cat: VOCERYQ ordering/shipping start (~late Dec 2026), full launch Q1 2027
rows.pitch: VOCERYQ won accelerated approval for RRP (81% fewer surgeries at 52 wk, n=32) with shipping about late Dec; a $336M cap is 1.7x the $202M peak estimate and cash is only $48M.

rows.name: Vaxart
rows.cat: COVID oral vaccine Ph2b topline by mid-2027
rows.pitch: Pill norovirus vaccine shows GI.1 antibodies +141% and GII.4 +94% in Ph1, but immunogenicity is not protection and Moderna is ~1-2 years ahead in Ph3; $88M cap is 2x the $44M weighted peak.

rows.name: ProKidney
rows.drug: Rilparencel (REACT) — autologous renal cell therapy (injected into kidney)
rows.cat: PROACT-1 Ph3 accelerated-approval cohort (n~320) topline eGFR-slope data
rows.pitch: Ph2 n=24 showed a 78% improvement in eGFR decline and FDA accepts slope for accelerated approval; $315M cap is 0.3x weighted peak, yet 3.7 quarters of cash is thin around the mid-2027 topline.

rows.name: Akebia
rows.cat: TDAPA expiry 12/31/26: Vafseo price reset (negative); 2027 refinancing
rows.pitch: Vafseo grew from $15.8M in Q1 to $21.3M in Q2 and VOICE interim was positive; $159M cash is 1.3x the $125M cap against $52M debt, with the 12/31/26 TDAPA price reset the key test.

rows.name: Unicycive
rows.drug: Oxylanthanum carbonate (OLC / Renazorb) — nanoparticle phosphate binder
rows.cat: FDA action on OLC NDA (PDUFA ~Mar 25 2027)
rows.pitch: The resubmission was accepted Oct 21 2026 after a CRL citing only manufacturing; PDUFA is ~Mar 25 2027, with $61M cash (8.9 quarters) vs a $103M cap, 0.36x our $288M weighted peak.

rows.name: Bausch
rows.drug: Larsucosterol (DURECT) -- now a wholly-owned Bausch Health asset (acquisition completed Sept 2025), within diversified, indebted Bausch Health
rows.cat: Larsucosterol Ph3 program design/initiation (pending); CVR milestones up to $350M tied to sales; Xifaxan LOE / B+L stake situation
rows.pitch: With $20.2B debt (6.3x the $3.2B cap), Xifaxan generics expected in 2028 and RED-C failed, larsucosterol (Ph2b missed survival primary, BTD, Ph3 in planning) is a minor option.

rows.name: Gyre
rows.indication: Liver fibrosis (chronic hepatitis B, China); MASH
rows.cat: Hydronidone China NDA decision; MASH
rows.pitch: Ph3 showed Ishak fibrosis regression; NDA is in NMPA priority review with conditional approval path and no approved China CHB competitor. $99M cash, $33M quarterly revenue.

rows.name: Beam
rows.drug: BEAM-302 (in vivo base editor correcting the AATD PiZ mutation) + risto-cel/BEAM-101 (ex vivo base-edited cell therapy for sickle cell disease)
rows.indication: Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency (AATD); sickle cell disease (risto-cel)
rows.cat: Risto-cel updated data + BLA submission as early as YE2026; BEAM-302 pivotal cohort dosing complete 1H27
rows.pitch: BEAM-302 lifted total AAT to 12.4 uM at 60mg (29 patients, no SAEs) and is in pivotal dosing; risto-cel BLA could come by YE26. $2.3B cap is ~0.4x our $5.4B weighted peak, with ~9.6 quarters of cash.

rows.name: Kamada
rows.drug: Diversified plasma/specialty portfolio (KEDRAB, CYTOGAM, hyperimmune Igs)
rows.cat: Detailed FY2027 guidance Jan 2027; additional biosimilar launches 2027; possible BD/M&A
rows.pitch: FY25 revenue $180.5M (+12%) and net income $20.2M (+40%), H1'26 revenue $100.2M (+13%); inhaled AAT is discontinued, so the $469M cap (2.6x sales, $75M cash) rides on KEDRAB-led execution.

rows.name: Vicore
rows.cat: ASPIRE Ph2b 52-week topline data in IPF, mid-2027
rows.pitch: Passing the iDMC futility look de-risks ASPIRE only modestly; the AIR Ph2a +23 mL FVC (n=48, vs external control) was uncontrolled. $286M cap vs $879M weighted peak, but $77M cash is 5.5 quarters.

rows.name: Sionna
rows.drug: SION-451 + SION-2222 (dual NBD1/NBD2 CFTR corrector combination)
rows.cat: AscenSION CF Ph2 proof-of-concept trial start (SION-451+SION-2222), Q1 2027
rows.pitch: Trading at 0.6x cash after SION-719 flatlined on sweat chloride (-1.0 mmol/L, p=0.7), the stock offers a cash floor, but SION-451+2222 is Ph1-only and its 28-day Ph2 starts Q1 2027 against Vertex.

rows.name: Trevi
rows.indication: Chronic cough in IPF; refractory chronic cough
rows.cat: LAKE RCC Ph2b sample-size re-estimation outcome early Q1 2027; OCEAN-2 and LAKE topline 2H 2027
rows.pitch: First-in-indication in IPF cough with a clean CORAL Ph2b (n=165), but opioid-class perception vs P2X3 rivals is open, and a $2.1B cap is 2.6x the $825M weighted peak. Next marker: LAKE re-estimation, early Q1 2027.

rows.name: United
rows.drug: Tyvaso (inhaled treprostinil) — IPF expansion (+ PAH franchise)
rows.cat: FDA action on Tyvaso IPF sNDA (review ends late April 2027)
rows.pitch: FDA review of the Tyvaso IPF sNDA ends late April 2027 after two positive Ph3s (+111.8 mL FVC), yet $25.0B is 6.0x our $4.2B peak and sotatercept pressures PAH; approval is the base case.

rows.name: Avalyn
rows.cat: MIST Ph2b topline FVC (2H2027)
rows.pitch: AP01 is inhaled pirfenidone, same molecule as generic oral; the $1.3B cap (cash $387M) is 5.1x our weighted peak ahead of MIST Ph2b FVC in 2H2027, while PureTech's Ph3 is already dosing.

rows.name: Contineum
rows.cat: PROPEL-IPF Ph2 FVC data
rows.pitch: With $245M cash funding to mid-2029, downside looks cushioned, yet PROPEL-IPF (n~324) has no guided topline, PIPE-791 is behind admilparant, and the pain crossover showed no clear significance.

rows.name: Savara
rows.cat: FDA PDUFA decision on molgramostim BLA (aPAP) on Nov 22, 2026; Priority Review, no AdCom
rows.pitch: Molgramostim PDUFA is Nov 22 (Priority Review, no AdCom) after a hit IMPALA-2 Ph3. $1.2B cap is ~2.6x the $455M peak estimate, $130M cash is 3.7 quarters, and the aPAP market is small.

rows.name: Korro
rows.cat: ANCHOR UCD patient dosing 1H27; interim data 2H27
rows.pitch: KRRO-121 is mouse and NHP data plus healthy-volunteer dosing since Sept 2026; UCD patients dose 1H27, interim data 2H27. $227M cap is 2.7x the ~$83M weighted peak, with $125M cash.

rows.name: Protalix
rows.cat: PRX-115 Ph2; Elfabrio Fabry ramp
rows.pitch: Profitable (H1'26 net income $22.1M incl. a $25M milestone; 2026 revenue guided $78-83M), so the $253M cap is ~1.3x our $200M weighted peak for PRX-115; Ph2 gout data, 2H 2027, face Krystexxa.

rows.name: Entera
rows.cat: EB613 Ph3 first site activation late 2026; Ph3 topline 2H 2028
rows.pitch: EB613 has a Ph2 (n=161) and FDA-accepted single Ph3 (~750 women, hip BMD at 12 months); $266M cash funds it into 2030, so a $599M cap vs $5.9B peak estimate rests on execution, not financing.

rows.name: Dr. Reddy's
rows.cat: Abatacept biosimilar FDA action (PDUFA 12/22/26); semaglutide supply resumes Nov 2026
rows.pitch: Semaglutide generics (non-inferior HbA1c, n=312) approved in 10 countries with supply resuming Nov 2026, plus an abatacept biosimilar PDUFA on Dec 22; $12B cap vs ~$6.8B weighted peak.

rows.name: Amphastar
rows.cat: BAQSIMI trajectory + injectable-generic launches
rows.pitch: BAQSIMI revenue of $58.8M (+10%) is about 28% of the $208M quarter, with Lilly and Xeris competing, rebate/340B pricing pressure and an open warning letter; $1.2B cap carries $613M of debt.

rows.name: Ionis
rows.cat: EU approval decision for TRYNGOLZA in sHTG (CHMP positive), guided Q4 2026
rows.pitch: First approved sHTG drug (TG down up to 72%); 2026 revenue guide $875-900M, breakeven targeted 2028. Offsets: pelacarsen miss, plozasiran mid-2027. Cap $4.7B vs $1.9B cash.

rows.name: Arrowhead
rows.drug: REDEMPLO (plozasiran, APOC3 siRNA, quarterly) + RNAi pipeline
rows.cat: FDA action on plozasiran sHTG sNDA (STAR 6-mo review); US launch targeted Q2 2027
rows.pitch: Approved for FCS; SHASTA-3/4 cut TG 79%/81% and pancreatitis events 78%, with sHTG in priority review. Ionis leads by 6-12 months; the $6.2B cap is 2.1x the $3.0B weighted peak.

rows.name: Editas
rows.drug: EDIT-401 -- in vivo CRISPR (LDLR upregulation, LDL-C lowering)
rows.indication: Hyperlipidemia / atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD), including heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)
rows.cat: First patient dosing by YE2026; initial Ph1/2 safety data Q1 2027
rows.pitch: EDIT-401 has only NHP data (~90% LDL-C cut) and GLP tox is ongoing; first dosing by YE2026, safety data Q1 2027. Verve is 2-3 years ahead in humans; $289M cap is 3.5x the $82M weighted peak.

rows.name: PTC
rows.cat: ST-920 Fabry rolling BLA completion; Sephience revenue ramp
rows.pitch: Q3 revenue $357.8M (Sephience $181.9M, +20% q/q) and FY26 guidance of $1.29-1.32B are a real base; yet the $5.1B cap is 3.4x the $1.5B peak estimate and Novartis controls votoplam in HD.

rows.name: Ascendis
rows.cat: European Commission decision on YUVIWEL (navepegritide) expected Q4 2026 after positive CHMP; EU launch Germany Q1 2027
rows.pitch: YORVIPATH grew 103% to EUR291M and 2026 operating cash flow is guided to at least EUR600M, yet the $18B cap is ~5.9x our $3.0B peak and YUVIWEL faces entrenched Voxzogo; the EC decision (Q4) is minor.

rows.name: Biomarin
rows.cat: VOXZOGO LTO FDA action (2027-02-28); HCH sNDA PDUFA 2027-05-30
rows.pitch: Diversified and profitable, with FY26 revenue guided to $3.33-3.43B; the $11B cap carries $4.2B debt and Ascendis competition, so the Feb 28, 2027 Voxzogo FDA action and hypochondroplasia sNDA matter.

rows.name: Disc
rows.cat: Bitopertin NDA resubmission by YE2026; FDA decision mid-2027
rows.pitch: APOLLO Ph3 met on PPIX (-41.4%, p<0.0001) and pain-free time (+12.2 hours); NDA resubmission by YE2026, decision mid-2027. $683M cash backs a $3.5B cap, 2.3x the $1.5B weighted peak.

rows.name: Denali
rows.cat: Q4 2026 AVLAYAH revenue guide $30-32M; DNL593 FTD-GRN data 1H 2027
rows.pitch: Avlayah Q3 revenue of $17.8M beat the $10-12M guide and Q4 is guided to $30-32M, but the LRRK2 Ph2b failure removes upside; $3.4B cap vs $1.0B cash and a $1.2B peak estimate leaves a balanced setup.

rows.name: Ultragenyx
rows.drug: Crysvita (XLH/TIO) + FAYUVI (UX111, MPS IIIA) + GENGLYCOS (DTX401, GSDIa)
rows.cat: DTX301 (OTC deficiency) Ph3 data on second primary endpoint; FAYUVI PRV sale closing late Nov 2026
rows.pitch: Crysvita ($109M of $173M Q3 revenue) anchors a $730-760M FY26 guide; GENGLYCOS and FAYUVI launched and GTX-102 is wound down. Cap $1.6B is ~2.2x sales against $401M cash and $1.2B debt.

rows.name: Zevra
rows.cat: MIPLYFFA infant (<24 mo) sNDA filing Q1 2027; EMA re-exam outcome and celiprolol FDA feedback undated
rows.pitch: MIPLYFFA is the only approved NPC drug and booked $34.0M in Q3, but total revenue fell from $39.7M in Q2 to $37.8M. Cash of $271M is 49% of the $550M cap; infant sNDA is due Q1 2027, and celiprolol Ph3 has 72 patients enrolled.

rows.name: Polaryx
rows.cat: SOTERIA first patient dosed (company-guided trial initiation Q4 2026); EU/UK approvals expected Q1 2027
rows.pitch: SOTERIA basket trial has Fast Track but only one US site active and no patient dosed; an $83M cap is ~10x $8M cash, 2.7 quarters of runway, so dilution precedes any single-arm data.

rows.name: Spruce
rows.cat: BLA submission for TA-ERT in MPS IIIB, guided December 2026
rows.pitch: TA-ERT normalized CSF HS-NRE and stabilized Bayley-III cognition over 6 years (n=22, natural-history comparison); BLA guided December. $88M cash vs $121M cap, $15M debt, 5.9 quarters runway.

rows.name: Monopar
rows.cat: Complete rolling NDA (guided within several weeks of Nov 12 2026), then FDA filing acceptance
rows.pitch: Pooled FoCus data (n=266) show UWDRS-III p=0.006 vs p=0.435 for standard chelation, though neuro benefit is post hoc; rolling NDA began Jul 22 and completes within weeks. Cap $620M, cash $129M.

rows.name: Amylyx
rows.cat: Avexitide NDA submission (PBH)
rows.pitch: LUCIDITY Ph3 hit (55% fewer Level 2/3 hypoglycemia events, p=0.000003) and no approved rival is within two years, but $3.6B is 2.8x our $1.26B weighted peak after a 93% 12-month run.

rows.name: Rezolute
rows.indication: Tumor-induced hypoglycemia / NICTH (upLIFT Ph3, primary near-term driver); congenital HI pursuing uncertain regulatory path after sunRIZE Ph3 missed primary & key secondary endpoints (~Dec 2025)
rows.cat: upLIFT Ph3 topline mid-Dec 2026; then BLA strategy (tumor + congenital HI) in 2027
rows.pitch: upLIFT topline lands mid-Dec 2026 on a single-arm, open-label n=16 study after the congenital-HI Ph3 missed; $375M cap vs $18M peak (~21x) and $90M cash leaves no cushion for a miss.

rows.name: Xeris
rows.cat: XP-8121 Ph3 Cornerstone start by YE2026 (topline late 2028, launch 2030); Recorlev ramp
rows.pitch: Recorlev grew 93% to $71.5M and total Q3 revenue rose 44% to $107.2M, with FY26 guided to $395-405M; a $3.1B cap is ~7.6x that, and XP-8121 Ph3 topline is late 2028. Cash $131M, debt $190M.

rows.name: MBX
rows.cat: MBX 4291 12-wk MAD unblinded data Q4 2026; canvuparatide Ph3 oPTimize enrolling (~160 pts)
rows.pitch: Canvuparatide showed 63% vs 31% responders at wk12 but trails YORVIPATH by 1-2 years; a $2.6B cap is 1.8x the $1.5B weighted peak, with $482M cash and MBX 4291 obesity data in Q4.

rows.name: Arcturus
rows.drug: ARCT-032 — inhaled mRNA (CFTR) — + other mRNA/OTC programs
rows.cat: ARCT-032 Ph2 Cohort 4 12-week data Q2 2027, with Ph3 go/no-go decision before
rows.pitch: ARCT-032 missed protocol FEV1 (post-hoc Day-42 signal only), so a $237M cap vs $185M cash (about $52M net) is fair; 12-week Cohort 4 data in Q2 2027 precedes a Ph3 decision.

rows.name: NewAmsterdam
rows.cat: PREVAIL interim analysis Q4 26 (results Q1 27); RUBENS topline ~YE26
rows.pitch: First global approval (EC, Sep 21) plus a 21% MACE signal (HR 0.79) and LDL-C -33% in BROADWAY; $2.3B cap is 3.6x its $643M cash. PREVAIL interim (4Q26) and RUBENS topline (~YE26) are the near-term tests.

rows.name: Monte Rosa
rows.cat: MRT-8102 GEMINI-1 gout Ph2 start Q4 2026 (data 2H 2027); CAD Ph2b H1 2027
rows.pitch: GFORCE-1 (n=108) cut NEK7 80-90% and hsCRP 85% with no SAEs, and $578M cash is 62% of the $933M cap; yet gout Ph2 data is 2H27, CAD efficacy is unproven and ziltivekimab leads by ~2 years.

rows.name: Amarin
rows.cat: Strategic review (Barclays) outcome, no date guided; Q4 positive operating cash flow, ~$330M YE cash
rows.pitch: The $238M cap is below $323M of cash, three straight quarters of positive cash flow and a completed $70M+ cost program, with a strategic review pending; US sales are flat near $36M a quarter.

rows.name: Madrigal
rows.cat: MAESTRO-NASH OUTCOMES (F4c) data late 2027; MAESTRO-CSPH start 1H27
rows.pitch: Rezdiffra's Q3 sales of $431.3M (+50% YoY, >55,850 patients) and first profitable quarter ($55.4M) de-risk the launch; $9.8B cap is ~1.9x our $5.2B peak, so F4c cirrhosis data (late 2027) and GLP-1 MASH share carry the upside.

rows.name: Inventiva
rows.cat: NATiV3 Ph3 topline Q4 2026; Q3 cash update Nov 23
rows.pitch: All 1,009 main-cohort pts finished 72 weeks; topline Q4 2026, funded through it ($272M cash). Ph2b fibrosis 48% vs 23%; cap is 0.6x the $1.9B weighted peak vs Rezdiffra's lead.

rows.name: Altimmune
rows.indication: MASH with fibrosis (F2-F3) [Phase 3, PERFORMA]; also Alcohol Use Disorder (Ph2, positive topline) and Alcohol-Associated Liver Disease (Ph2)
rows.cat: FDA End-of-Phase 2 meeting for AUD (Dec 2026); PERFORMA MASH Ph3 52-wk topline 2029
rows.pitch: Cash is 1.5x the $320M cap after a 66% 12-month slide, so PERFORMA Ph3 (MASH, data 2029) and the positive AUD Ph2 come free; the missed 24-week fibrosis endpoint and a crowded field are the reasons.

rows.name: Galectin
rows.cat: Annual stockholders meeting Dec 3 2026 with additional Ph3 information expected; Ph3 start not yet guided
rows.pitch: FDA agreed a traditional pathway on a composite clinical endpoint in MASH cirrhosis, but NAVIGATE missed FAS significance (p=0.13) and cash of $12M funds only to June 2027.

rows.name: Rhythm
rows.cat: Bivamelagon Ph3 initiation (acquired HO) by YE2026; EMANATE Ph3 (genetic obesity) MISSED primary endpoint across all 4 cohorts (post-hoc signal only in POMC/PCSK1 & SRC1 subgroups) -- company reassessing path for bivamelagon/RM-718
rows.pitch: Imcivree sells ($92M a quarter) and TRANSCEND was positive, but an extended PDUFA and the EMANATE miss leave bivamelagon Ph3 (start by YE2026) carrying a $7.7B cap, 3.6x our $2.2B weighted peak.

rows.name: Viking
rows.drug: VK2735 — subcutaneous + oral GLP-1/GIP dual agonist
rows.cat: VANQUISH-1/2 78-wk Ph3 completion in 2027; extension studies start 1Q27; maintenance Part 2 results 2027
rows.pitch: VK2735 posted 14.7% (SC) and 12.2% (oral) weight loss at 13 weeks; with $960M cash the $3.4B cap is ~1.8x the $1.9B weighted peak, so VANQUISH completion in 2027 must beat tirzepatide to re-rate.

rows.name: Kailera
rows.cat: Oral ribupatide Ph3 start 1H27; inj Ph2b high-dose and safiglipron Ph2 data mid-2027; KaiNETIC Ph3 data mid-2028
rows.pitch: Fully enrolled 5,000-pt KaiNETIC Ph3 reads out mid-2028, with the oral ribupatide Ph3 start 1H27; $1.04B cash is 64% of cap. Tirzepatide and Structure's oral GLP-1 (16.3%) are ahead on proof.

rows.name: Structure
rows.cat: Q4 2026 topline: 44-wk body-composition, 30-wk T2D and SWITCH studies; ACCOMPLISH topline 2H 2028
rows.pitch: Ph2b gave ~16% placebo-adjusted loss at 44 weeks with 2-3% AE discontinuation; Ph3 is dosing. Cash of $1.24B is 91% of cap and funds through 2028; orforglipron sets the bar.

rows.name: Wave
rows.cat: WVE-006 600mg multidose data Q4'26; WVE-007 600mg SAD data Q4'26; $12M GSK milestone Q4
rows.pitch: With $431M cash against a $586M cap, the pipeline (DMD at 7.8% mean dystrophin, HD, RNA-editing AATD with FDA-endorsed accelerated path) is valued at ~$155M; Q4 multidose data and a $12M GSK milestone are the near tests.

rows.name: BioAge
rows.indication: Cardiovascular residual inflammatory risk (ASCVD, hsCRP-driven) + diabetic macular edema/retinal disease
rows.cat: QUELL-CV Ph2 topline (12-week hsCRP) in Q4 2026
rows.pitch: QUELL-CV Ph2 (n~160) reads 12-week hsCRP in Q4 2026 after ~86% Ph1 cuts. Cash is 1.5x cap, cushioning a miss; MACE benefit is unproven and Novo's injectable ziltivekimab leads.

rows.name: Vivani
rows.cat: Start of NPM-139 Ph2 dose-ranging weight-maintenance trial in 2027; Novo Nordisk evaluation ongoing
rows.pitch: SLIM-1 (n=10 per arm, 4 wks): weight loss 0.79% vs 0.82% on Wegovy, 0/10 vs 5/10 AEs; a financing is the near-term issue with $15M cash vs $95M cap, though the Novo evaluation adds option value.

rows.name: Fractyl
rows.drug: Revita — duodenal mucosal resurfacing (endoscopic) for GLP-1 maintenance
rows.cat: REMAIN-1 12-month pivotal topline Q1 2027; De Novo submission late Q4 2026
rows.pitch: Pivotal 6-month win (n=308, p=0.0023, no device SAEs); De Novo filing late Q4. Runway reaches only Q2 2027, so a raise likely accompanies 12-month data; $151M cap vs $47M cash.

rows.name: Rani
rows.drug: RT-114 (RaniPill) — oral GLP-1/GLP-2 via ingestible capsule
rows.cat: RT-114 Ph1a expansion data by year-end 2026
rows.pitch: RaniPill delivered >150% of SC bioavailability in 30 volunteers, yet efficacy is unproven against Rybelsus and orforglipron; $75M cap vs ~$164M probability-weighted peak, with 5.6 quarters of runway and Nasdaq bid risk near $1.

rows.name: Vericel
rows.cat: FY2026 results and FY27 guidance Q1 2027; MACI ankle FDA decision (undated); MACI UK launch 2027
rows.pitch: Q3 revenue rose 26% to $85.4M (MACI +21%, burn care +52%) and FY26 guidance rose to $344-346M, yet the $2.9B cap is ~8.5x that revenue, leaving little for the multiple to do before the Q1 2027 FY27 guide.

rows.name: Edgewise
rows.cat: EDG-7500 Phase 3 HCM initiation
rows.pitch: EDG-7500 showed no LVEF drop in oHCM and nHCM (n=53, open-label, 12 weeks), a possible edge vs mavacamten and aficamten, but unproven vs placebo. The $4.8B cap is 3.3x the $1.5B weighted peak; Ph3 starts Q4.

rows.name: Dyne
rows.cat: PDUFA decision (Jan 21, 2027)
rows.pitch: BLA on Priority Review with a Jan 21 2027 PDUFA; dystrophin rose from 0.83% to 5.46% vs Sarepta's ~1%. At $3.1B the cap is 2.1x our $1.5B peak, cushioned by $1.1B cash, so gains hinge on the 53/45 multi-exon and DM1 programs.

rows.name: Sarepta
rows.cat: Q4 2026 SRP-1003 (DM1) and SRP-1001 (FSHD) MAD data; Q4 ELEVIDYS revenue in line with Q3; PMO sNDA PDUFA 2/28/27 per prior listing, unconfirmed
rows.pitch: Net product revenue was $323.8M in Q3 (PMO $240.3M, Elevidys $83.5M); $1.6B cap is ~1.3x annualized sales and cash of $999M exceeds $857M debt. Safety deaths and the ambulatory-only label cap it; a label regain would be upside.

rows.name: Solid
rows.drug: SGT-003 — next-gen AAV micro-dystrophin gene therapy
rows.cat: FDA meeting on accelerated approval pathway (late Q4 2026)
rows.pitch: SGT-003 micro-dystrophin rose from 58% to ~100% by Day 360 on a next-gen capsid, and Ph3 is dosing. But a $1.0B cap exceeds 35% x $2.5B (~$880M); Ph3 data are years out, so the Dec Type C meeting on accelerated approval is the test.

rows.name: REGENXBIO
rows.cat: Sura-vec wet AMD pivotal topline Q4 2026; RGX-202 pre-BLA meeting Q4 2026, BLA submission Q1 2027
rows.pitch: AFFINITY DUCHENNE met its primary endpoint with 93% of patients above 10% micro-dystrophin (p<0.0001); BLA is due Q1 2027. Cap is $492M against $251M cash and $186M debt, and external-control data face FDA scrutiny.

rows.name: Entrada
rows.cat: ELEVATE-44 Cohort 1 open-label data by YE2026; Cohort 2 (12mg/kg) data Q1 2027
rows.pitch: Cash of $193M covers 91% of the $213M cap, which cushions the downside, but Cohort 1 (n=8) moved dystrophin only +2.36% over a 4.00% baseline. Cohort 1 data are due by YE2026 and Cohort 2 (12 mg/kg) in Q1 2027.

rows.name: Capricor
rows.cat: FDA PDUFA decision on deramiocel (upper-limb indication)
rows.pitch: FDA panel voted 3-9 against effectiveness for cardiomyopathy, so Capricor narrowed to upper limb, where HOPE-3 (n=106) showed 54% slowing, p=0.03. The Nov 22 decision is binary; $199M cash is 41% of the $483M cap, with an activist pushing the board.

rows.name: Cumberland
rows.cat: Rolling NDA submission for ifetroban in DMD cardiomyopathy (pre-NDA held; no date guided)
rows.pitch: After selling its brands to Apotex for $100M and paying a $1.50 special dividend, Cumberland trades at $78M vs $81M cash. Ifetroban showed a ~5.4% LVEF benefit in 41 DMD patients, but no Ph3 design or funding has been announced.

rows.name: Benitec
rows.cat: ESGCT poster Oct 27-30; FDA confirmation of pivotal design 1Q27; pivotal start mid-2027
rows.pitch: BB-301 hit 6/6 low-dose responders at 12 months and 3/3 at high dose with no SAEs in a disease with no approved gene therapy. $176M cash is 42% of the $423M cap; FDA pivotal design is due 1Q27, start mid-2027, so it is a small-n bet.

rows.name: PepGen
rows.cat: FREEDOM-OLE interim data Jan 2027; 12.5 mg/kg cohort data 1H 2027
rows.pitch: FREEDOM2-DM1 showed 46.5% splicing correction vs 6.8% placebo, with grip +16.2% and no SAEs, but only 8 patients, no p-value and inconclusive PROs. The US hold persists; $105M cash is 39% of the $269M cap, with OLE data Jan 2027.

rows.name: Scholar Rock
rows.indication: Spinal muscular atrophy (SMA, on background SMN therapy)
rows.cat: EU CHMP opinion on apitegromab MAA 1H 2027; Japan priority review; SRK-439 Ph1 data YE 2026
rows.pitch: ISEMBYLD was approved Sep 11 and the launch is underway, with EU CHMP opinion in 1H 2027. But a $5.9B cap is ~4.9x our $1.2B peak estimate for an SMA add-on on near-zero revenue so far; obesity optionality is unproven.

rows.name: Jyong
rows.cat: API comparability / strategy post-failure
rows.pitch: The US API-1 pivotal failed vs placebo and the original source is unavailable, so a comparability study delays a combined NDA to 2029-2030; $1M cash vs $135M cap means near-term dilution.

rows.name: Xenon
rows.cat: FDA NDA acceptance/PDUFA date for azetukalner in FOS (not yet reported); X-NOVA2 MDD topline Dec 2026; AES Dec 4-8
rows.pitch: X-TOLE2 showed -42.7% placebo-adjusted (p<0.0001) and the NDA went in Sep 17 with a filing decision due mid-Nov; the market has marked down the psychiatry pause, leaving ~$2.7B of enterprise value on epilepsy.

rows.name: Rapport
rows.indication: Drug-resistant focal (onset) epilepsy (lead, Ph3); bipolar mania (Ph2, secondary indication)
rows.cat: Initial open-label long-term safety data for RAP-219 epilepsy, 4Q 2026; FDA EOP2 mania meeting 1Q 2027
rows.pitch: RAP-219 FOCUS 1/2 Ph3 enrolling, runway through 2029 on ~$815M pro forma cash vs a $1.4B cap; a positive mania Ph2 adds a second shot, though 72% seizure reduction came from an open-label n=27.

rows.name: Biohaven
rows.drug: BHV-1300 (MoDE extracellular IgG degrader, Graves') + BHV-1400 (IgAN); troriluzole (SCA -- FDA Complete Response Letter received Nov 2025, NOT commercial)
rows.indication: Graves' disease (BHV-1300, Phase 3); IgA nephropathy (BHV-1400, Phase 1b); spinocerebellar ataxia (troriluzole -- FDA CRL Nov 2025)
rows.cat: BHV-1400 IgAN Ph3 start 4Q26; troriluzole SCA PDUFA 1Q27; BHV-1300 Graves Ph3 enrolling
rows.pitch: Ono ($80M upfront) and SK ($350M) deals ease $164M cash vs $264M debt, but troriluzole drew a CRL and Graves' Ph3 is just starting; $2.1B cap is ~0.9x our $2.3B weighted peak.

rows.name: Bright Minds
rows.cat: FDA full partial-hold letter due ~30 days from 11/2/26 notice; hold resolution timing unknown
rows.pitch: Cash of $225M with no debt exceeds the $217M cap even after a 58% one-month drop, so the open-label Ph2 (73.1% median absence-seizure reduction, 24 pts) is free; the full FDA hold letter due ~Dec 2 sets the risk.

rows.name: Ovid
rows.cat: OV329 photosensitivity (PPR) study topline, Q1 2027; adult focal Ph2 readout 2H 2027
rows.pitch: A $519M cap is 1.6x the ~$331M weighted peak (28% x $1.2B) for a drug with no efficacy data; cash of $161M gives runway into 2029, so wait for the Q1 2027 PPR study and the 2H 2027 focal Ph2.

rows.name: Stoke
rows.cat: EMPEROR Ph3 topline (guided Q3 2027); NDA completion H2 2027
rows.pitch: Zorevunersen's ~80% durable seizure cut plus cognitive gains argue for the call, with no approved disease-modifier in SCN1A Dravet; but EMPEROR topline is not until Q3 2027 and cash is $359M.

rows.name: CAMP4
rows.cat: ASCEND Ph1/2 first patient dosed, guided by year-end 2026
rows.pitch: The $350M cap is 2.8x cash of $125M for a program with only seizure-model data; trials are cleared in Australia, Argentina, UK and EU, and the cap is 3.4x the ~$104M weighted peak (12% x $875M), leaving no margin for a human miss.

rows.name: AbCellera
rows.cat: Late-stage ABCL635 menopausal VMS development start in 2027; cancer-related VMS trials start 2027
rows.pitch: The positive Ph2 (83% vs 33% frequency reduction) already sits in a $3.6B cap, 1.8x the ~$2.0B weighted peak (27% x $7.2B); with Veoza and elinzanetant approved and Ph3 not until 2027, upside needs replication.

rows.name: Praxis
rows.cat: Relutrigine NDA PDUFA 12/27/26; ulixacaltamide ET NDA PDUFA 1/29/27; EMERALD DEE topline Q4 2026
rows.pitch: Ph3 ESSENTIAL3 hit (mADL11 -4.3 vs -1.7) and a Jan 29 PDUFA at 97% PoS, plus a second NDA (relutrigine, Dec 27), but $9.1B is 4x our $2.25B peak, leaving little for the base case to add.

rows.name: Prothena
rows.cat: Moponetug (BMS tau) Ph2 TargetTau-1 data 1H 2027; PARAISO Ph3 primary completion 2029
rows.pitch: Cash of $271M is 66% of the $409M cap; prasinezumab Ph3 PARAISO (n~900) completes in 2029 after a narrow PADOVA miss, and Prothena gets only royalties and milestones.

rows.name: Design
rows.cat: Q4'26 registrational-path update (DT-216P2); 12-wk RESTORE-FA data Q1'27; Q3 results
rows.pitch: The $635M cap is 3.0x its $209M cash and 4.8x our ~$133M weighted peak (15% x $875M) on 4-week data, with 12-week durability due Q1 2027 and Larimar's BLA already submitted.

rows.name: NervGen
rows.cat: Type B FDA meeting request; RESTORE enrollment completion 2H 2027; topline 1H 2028
rows.pitch: NVG-291 showed GRASSP +3.7 vs +0.4 placebo (n~24, p=0.0155) in chronic SCI and now has Breakthrough designation; cash of $57M (29% of the $196M cap) is guided to last 12 quarters, past the 1H 2028 RESTORE topline.

rows.name: Alkermes
rows.cat: Brilliance Ph3 narcolepsy topline beginning mid-2027; VIBRANCE-3 IH Ph2 data ~YE2026/early 2027
rows.pitch: Takeda's ORZEYFUL was approved Aug 5, so alixorexton (Ph3 topline from mid-2027) is a follower: ~$1.5B weighted peak (62% x $2.4B) versus an $8.2B cap supported by ~$480M of quarterly revenue.

rows.name: Harmony
rows.indication: Narcolepsy (EDS/cataplexy, approved); Prader-Willi Syndrome EDS (Ph3, TEMPO); idiopathic hypersomnia (Pitolisant HD, Ph3 planned after prior IH program's FDA Refusal to File)
rows.cat: Jan 26 2027 AET ANDA injunction hearing; Pitolisant GR PDUFA Apr 1 2027; TEMPO topline mid-2027
rows.pitch: WAKIX grew 30% to a record ~$261M in Q2, and $1.1B cash is 54% of the $1.9B cap (debt $150M); the open question is orexin-agonist erosion, while the Apr 1 2027 PDUFA for pitolisant GR extends the franchise.

rows.name: Axsome
rows.cat: ENGAGE solriamfetol BED Ph3 topline 1Q 2027; AXS-12 cataplexy PDUFA 5/1/27
rows.pitch: Quarterly revenue is $260M and Auvelity peak guidance is $8B after the Apr 30 agitation approval, vs a $7.2B cap; solriamfetol Ph3 (1Q27) and AXS-12 PDUFA add legs.

rows.name: Anavex
rows.cat: US AD Ph3 design / Rett RS-005 start; FY2026 10-K update
rows.pitch: The EMA MAA was withdrawn Mar 25 after a negative CHMP and a new US Ph3 has no start date; cash of $118M (1.6x the $76M cap) is no floor for a stock down 86% in 12 months.

rows.name: Voyager
rows.cat: VY7523 tau-PET/clinical data (Q4 2026 per company guidance)
rows.pitch: Cash of $132M is 1.3x the $101M cap going into VY7523 tau-PET data (Q4 2026) and VY1706 safety (Q1 2027); anti-tau efficacy is unproven and UCB and J&J are well funded.

rows.name: Alpha Cognition
rows.cat: CONVERGE real-world evidence dataset update, December 2026
rows.pitch: Q3 net revenue of $7.8M (+30% QoQ, +230% YoY) with 1,639 prescribers (+22%) and $38M cash, no debt; the bet is premium pricing holding against sub-$5 generic donepezil and profitability in 2027.

rows.name: Coya
rows.cat: ALSTARS Ph2/3 24-week double-blind topline, early Q2 2027
rows.pitch: No efficacy data until the 24-week ALSTARS topline (early Q2 2027, 137 pts, fully enrolled); $36M cash is about half the $70M cap and funds only into 2H 2027; AMX0035 and tofersen are approved.

rows.name: MediciNova
rows.cat: COMBAT-ALS double-blind topline results by end of 2026
rows.pitch: Topline from the 234-patient COMBAT-ALS Ph2b/3 is due by end of 2026; $66M cap vs $29M cash and a ~$34M weighted peak (19% x $180M), against approved AMX0035 and tofersen.

rows.name: Cognition
rows.cat: DLB Phase 3 start (no date given; earlier guide mid-2027); START AD Ph2 topline 2H 2027
rows.pitch: SHIMMER (n=130) met safety but NPI-12 slowing of 86% missed significance (p=0.0545); FDA aligned on Ph3 endpoints, no start date, neflamapimod is ahead, cash $32M vs a $61M cap.

rows.name: Alector
rows.drug: AL137 (ABC-enabled anti-amyloid) — Alector Brain Carrier platform
rows.cat: AL137 first-in-human dosing in Australia (no later than Apr 2027); US IND Q2 2027
rows.pitch: After INFRONT-3 and a second progranulin failure, the value is cash ($139M, 36% of cap) plus the Genentech AL050 deal; AL137 first-in-human slipped to Apr 2027, so $383M leaves nothing for a miss.

rows.name: uniQure
rows.drug: AMT-130 — one-time AAV gene therapy (lowers huntingtin)
rows.cat: FDA PDUFA action date for AMT-130 BLA (May 1, 2027)
rows.pitch: BLA accepted with a May 1 2027 PDUFA on n=12 data vs external control, after FDA reversals; the $1.5B cap is ~2.1x our 32% x $2.25B weighted peak, but $768M cash (vs $548M debt) cushions.

rows.name: Alterity
rows.drug: ATH434 — oral iron-redistribution / α-synuclein aggregation inhibitor
rows.cat: ATH434 MSA Ph3 initiation, no start date guided; partnering/funding evaluation ongoing
rows.pitch: FDA allowed one ~200-pt pivotal Ph3 on the 50 mg dose, yet the Ph3 is unfunded and 75 mg was not significant; with $27M cash vs a $431M cap, partnering or a raise comes before any start.

rows.name: AC Immune
rows.cat: ACI-7104 antibody characterization data by YE2026; FDA discussions on development path early 2027
rows.pitch: VacSYn Ph2 (n=34) met safety and immunogenicity endpoints with antibodies in CSF, and cash is 65% of the cap; efficacy is unproven, runway ends Q4 2027, and a CEO search is under way.

rows.name: Taysha
rows.cat: 6-mo interim topline + FDA BLA-path feedback guided only "1H 2027" (date unconfirmed)
rows.pitch: REVEAL pivotal is fully dosed (17 pts) with no treatment-related SAEs across N=29; $423M cash covers the 1H27 interim and BLA-path feedback, though Neurogene's NGN-401 is ahead on enrollment.

rows.name: Neurogene
rows.cat: Embolden registrational topline 2H 2027 (9 of 25 responders needed)
rows.pitch: Embolden is fully dosed (25 pts, 9 responders needed, topline 2H 2027) and $360M cash is 56% of the $640M cap, against a ~$3.2B weighted peak (40% x $8B); the Ph1/2 was only n=10, so the pivotal decides it.

rows.name: Acadia
rows.cat: Remlifanserin Ph2 readout in Lewy body dementia psychosis, Q4 2027 (RADIANT detail at CTAD Nov 17 2026)
rows.pitch: Nuplazid and Daybue grew Q3 revenue 23% to $342M against FY26 guidance of $1.265-1.295B, so the $3.2B cap is ~2.5x sales, with $976M cash; RADIANT missed its primary (p=0.0603) and AD psychosis is a graveyard.

rows.name: Lexicon
rows.indication: Heart failure (INPEFA, commercial) + T1D (Zynquista); obesity (LX9851, Novo-partnered); pilavapadin/DPNP (partnered optionality)
rows.cat: SONATA-HCM Ph3 topline and Zynquista NDA resubmission, both Q1 2027
rows.pitch: INPEFA, a dual SGLT1/2, is up against genericizing SGLT2s, so the $779M cap (4.3x $183M cash) rides on SONATA-HCM Ph3 topline and Zynquista NDA resubmission, both Q1 2027, plus Novo's LX9851 obesity deal.

rows.name: OKYO
rows.cat: NEPTUNE Ph3 enrollment ongoing; no topline timing guided; BTD not announced
rows.pitch: Urcosimod has no approved NCP competitor and Ph2a showed VAS -5.5 vs -2.75, yet only 6 vs 6 patients; NEPTUNE Ph3 started Oct 2026, with $21M cash vs a $62M cap, so a raise is likely.

rows.name: Anika
rows.stage: Phase 3 complete, pre-NDA (Cingal); Hyalofast PMA deficiency response pending
rows.drug: Hyalofast (HA-based scaffold for cartilage repair) — primary near-term regulatory catalyst; Cingal (single-injection HA+steroid) is marketed OUS only, with no active US regulatory path
rows.indication: Knee cartilage defect repair (Hyalofast, US pipeline); knee osteoarthritis pain (Cingal — ex-US commercial only, not a US pipeline asset)
rows.cat: Cingal bioequivalence study completion and NDA submission by end of 2027; FDA path for Hyalofast to be defined
rows.pitch: FDA deemed the Hyalofast PMA not approvable (Oct 2026) and Cingal is ex-US only, with an NDA planned by end-2027 after BE enrollment closed in Sep. Cap $170M vs $45M cash and ~$31M quarterly revenue.

rows.name: Nutriband
rows.cat: HAP study initiation/IND filing
rows.pitch: AVERSA fentanyl is preclinical with the pivotal HAP study not yet started and no efficacy data; $71M cap is ~3x the 15% x $153M weighted peak, against $3M cash and ~6 quarters of runway.

rows.name: Heron
rows.cat: Close of CorMedix asset purchase (Heron stockholder vote and HSR clearance) expected Q1 2027
rows.pitch: Asset sale to CorMedix needs a Heron stockholder vote and HSR clearance, closing Q1 2027. Q2'26 revenue $37.7M missed management's plan and guidance was withdrawn; $51M cap, $23M cash, $126M debt.

rows.name: Halozyme
rows.cat: Partner SC launches; new ENHANZE deals
rows.pitch: Q3 revenue $493.0M (+39%), royalties $341.0M, FY26 revenue guide raised to $1.860-1.925B; yet the $11B cap is 4.2x our $2.6B peak, with $3.25B debt and Merck litigation over ENHANZE unresolved.

rows.name: Collegium
rows.cat: Q4 2026 $50M ASR final settlement; FY26 guidance delivery; BD/debt paydown
rows.pitch: Q3 product revenue $216.3M (+3%): JORNAY PM +24% to $51.9M, pain portfolio -18% to $138.0M; FY26 guide $825-855M reaffirmed. Cap $828M vs $145M cash and $1.08B debt; debt paydown is the lever.

rows.name: Cingulate
rows.cat: CTx-1301 NDA resubmission (post-CRL), expected Dec 2026-Jan 2027
rows.pitch: CTx-1301 met Ph3 endpoints and drew a manufacturing-only CRL (Jun 2026); resubmission is due Dec 2026-Jan 2027. $55M cap vs $23M cash (3.4 quarters runway) in a crowded stimulant field.

rows.name: Neumora
rows.cat: Phase 2 AD-agitation study start (no date in Q3 PR; prior guide by YE2026); financing needed
rows.pitch: Cap $70M vs $86M cash and $55M debt; Ph1b showed a 15.7-point CMAI reduction and Ph2 is enabled, but no start date, 2.8 quarters of runway and a failed navacaprant mean financing precedes any rerating.

rows.name: Definium
rows.cat: DT120 ODT NDA filing 1H 2027; First Commercial Day 1H 2027
rows.pitch: DT120 has three positive Ph3s (GAD HAM-A -5.4 and -5.1, MDD MADRS -8.1), Breakthrough in MDD, and ~$1.05B cash into 2030; NDA is 1H 2027, yet the $4.1B cap is 1.4x our $3.0B peak.

rows.name: Neurocrine
rows.stage: Commercial (Ingrezza, Crenessity, Vykat XR); lead pipeline osavampator Ph3
rows.cat: Osavampator Ph3 (adjunctive MDD)
rows.pitch: Ingrezza and Crenessity support the $17B cap, but osavampator's Ph3 (mid-2027) must repeat SAVITRI's -7.5 MADRS in a crowded augment market (Auvelity, Rexulti, generic Abilify).

rows.name: GH Research
rows.cat: FDA End-of-Phase 2 meeting Q1 2027, then pivotal TRD program start
rows.pitch: Ph2b TRD showed MADRS -15.5 vs placebo at Day 8 (p<0.001) and the FDA hold lifted Jan 2026; the $1.3B cap is about the $1.4B weighted peak, with $351M cash and an end-of-Ph2 meeting in Q1 2027.

rows.name: Seaport
rows.cat: BUOY-1 Ph2 (MDD)
rows.pitch: Well funded ($404M, runway into 2029) but a $1.0B cap already credits GlyphAllo before any Ph2b efficacy; BUOY-1 (up to 360 pts) reads 1H 2027 against approved zuranolone.

rows.name: Alto
rows.cat: PACE-2 Ph3 initiation early 2027 (pending FDA alignment); PACE-1 Ph2b topline 2H 2027
rows.pitch: Alto's biomarker-selected ALTO-207 has only a 32-patient Ph2a (d=1.1), and the $1.3B cap is 2x the 27% x $2.4B weighted peak; PACE-2 Ph3 starts early 2027, PACE-1 topline 2H 2027, ALTO-101 missed.

rows.name: Helus
rows.cat: EMBRACE second pivotal Ph3 topline, 4Q 2027
rows.pitch: Ph3 APPROACH hit at wk 6 (MADRS -7.6 vs placebo, remission 50.9% vs 18.2%, n=222) with Breakthrough status; the $583M cap sits against $171M cash, and EMBRACE reads 4Q 2027.

rows.name: NRx
rows.cat: Rolling NRX-100 NDA submission by year-end 2026; first ketamine shipments by Jan 2027
rows.pitch: Approval is done (Oct 2026) and shipments start by Jan 2027; the test is a rolling NRX-100 NDA by year-end after repeated delays since 2024, on only $27M cash vs a $102M cap.

rows.name: LB Pharma
rows.cat: NOVA-2 Ph3 topline data (accelerated, 1H 2027)
rows.pitch: Faster NOVA-2 enrollment pulled topline to 1H 2027; $1.5B cap vs $404M cash and ~$2.4B weighted peak (65% x $3.75B), with the bar set by cheap D2 generics and Cobenfy.

rows.name: Vanda
rows.cat: Quimilza (GPP BLA) PDUFA Dec 12 2026; BYSANTI launch Q4; HETLIOZ jet lag hearing Dec 14-18
rows.pitch: Q3 net product sales of $69.8M and FY26 guidance above $240M sit against a $230M cap and $141M cash; Quimilza PDUFA Dec 12 and BYSANTI's launch vs entrenched generics decide it.

rows.name: Minerva
rows.cat: MIN-101C19 Part A topline (2H 2027)
rows.pitch: Roluperidone's confirmatory Ph3 (~380 pts, Part A 2H 2027) follows a prior FDA rejection; $166M cap vs $77M cash and $60M debt, with 0.6 quarters of runway forcing a raise first.

rows.name: MapLight
rows.drug: ML-007C-MA — M1/M4 muscarinic agonist (+ tolerability agent)
rows.cat: VISTA Ph2 (Alzheimer's disease psychosis) topline; FDA EOP2 meeting and ZEPHYR-2 start earlier, undated
rows.pitch: Trades at 0.9x its $463M cash ($415M cap) after a 55% 12-month slide; ZEPHYR met its primary (-4.5 PANSS, p=0.015) but ZEPHYR-2 reads 2028, behind approved Cobenfy.

rows.name: Emergent
rows.cat: No dated catalyst: NARCAN share vs generics and US government MCM contract awards; interim CFO from Jan 1 2027
rows.pitch: NARCAN is eroding: Q3 revenue -52% to $110M, naloxone -42% to $43.5M, FY26 guide cut to $600-645M. Debt of $514M exceeds the $299M cap; $176M cash cushions but does not fix it.

rows.name: Achieve
rows.cat: Cytisinicline NDA resubmission (post-CRL); approval decision 1H 2027
rows.pitch: Cytisinicline's June CRL was CMC and labeling only; ORCA-2 abstinence was 32.6% vs 7.0% and 52-wk quit rates reached 31.2%. Resubmission is on track for Q4 2026; $667M cap vs $202M cash.

rows.name: Braveheart
rows.cat: Hengrui China Ph3 topline (oHCM) 1H 2027; LIONHEART-HCM interim 2H 2027
rows.pitch: A $1.8B cap is 2.1x the $840M weighted peak (28% x $3B) for a Ph3 myosin inhibitor behind mavacamten, aficamten and EDG-7500; Hengrui China Ph3 topline 1H27 is the first efficacy test, $504M cash buys time only.

rows.name: Apnimed
rows.cat: AD109 (Oxnimbi) PDUFA Feb 28 2027
rows.pitch: First oral OSA combo with positive SynAIRgy (n=646) and LunAIRo Ph3s, PDUFA Feb 28 2027; $678M cap (cash $352M) is 0.2x weighted peak, with dry mouth, insomnia and coverage the open issues.

rows.name: Latigo
rows.cat: Ph3 bunionectomy and safety trials start (undated, on track); topline 2H 2027
rows.pitch: Onzotrigine hit its Ph2b primary (n=343, NEJM Jul 2026) and has $401M cash, but the $835M cap is 2x the 35% x $1.2B weighted peak and Vertex's Journavx leads; Ph3 topline is 2H 2027.

rows.name: Obsidian
rows.drug: OBX-115 — engineered TIL armored with membrane-bound IL-15
rows.cat: Registration-enabling cohort topline expected year-end 2027 (enrollment complete end Q1 2027; NSCLC Ph1 data 1H 2027)
rows.pitch: OBX-115 posted 67% confirmed ORR (10/15) with no DLTs or ICANS and mDOR not reached at 14.3 months, but n=15 is cross-trial against approved Amtagvi, which already earns about $102M a quarter in US sales. $763M cap vs $324M cash is fair, not cheap.

rows.name: Attovia
rows.indication: Chronic pruritus of unknown origin (CPUO); high-itch atopic dermatitis
rows.cat: ATTUNE-CPUO and ATTUNE-AD Ph2 trial initiations (1H 2027)
rows.pitch: Single-dose Ph1b showed CPUO PP-NRS4 82% vs 22% placebo and ~95% IL-31 suppression, with cash at 59% of a $673M cap. Still small-n (AD 18 vs 8), Ph2 only starts 1H 2027 and Nemluvio/Dupixent set the bar, so we hold.

rows.name: BlossomHill
rows.drug: BH-30643 — macrocyclic OMNI-EGFR inhibitor (+ BH-30236 CLK)
rows.cat: First patient dosed in pivotal Ph2 SOLARA-2 (Q1 2027); updated Ph1 C797S durability data 1H 2027
rows.pitch: SOLARA's 45% ORR (18/40) and 88% DCR in C797S+ NSCLC are encouraging, yet single-arm with 6.9-mo follow-up; the $434M cap is 1.9x $225M cash, and pivotal SOLARA-2 starts Q1 2027.

rows.name: Scribe
rows.drug: STX-1150 (renamed, formerly STX-115) — CRISPR-CasX epigenetic silencing (PCSK9) for LDL-C (+ STX-1200 Lp(a), STX-1400 TG)
rows.cat: STX-1150 Ph1 initial SAD data (safety, LDL-C lowering) in 1H 2027
rows.pitch: STX-1150 cut LDL-C >50% in NHPs for nearly 18 months, but the cap of $291M is already ~0.8x our $350M weighted peak and Verve/Lilly lead in the clinic; Ph1 SAD data (1H27) is the first human test.

rows.name: Vogenx
rows.indication: Post-bariatric hypoglycemia (PBH); gastroparesis; GIP-dependent Cushing's syndrome
rows.cat: EMERGE Ph2b (PBH) topline data, guided 2H 2027
rows.pitch: Gut-restricted SGLT1 inhibitor with 2 completed Ph2s in PBH and $82M of cash (cap is 2.6x cash), but EMERGE Ph2b topline is 2H 2027 and Amylyx's avexitide is ahead.

rows.name: Clinuvel
rows.cat: CUV105 vitiligo Ph3 topline Dec 2026 (per Jul 2026 guidance); CUV107 pivotal start Nov 2026
rows.pitch: Scenesse is the sole approved EPP drug with ~$60-90M revenue and profits; EV is ~$77M after $174M cash, so the Dec 2026 vitiligo Ph3 is cheap optionality, with Disc's bitopertin the competitive threat.

rows.name: Veraxa
rows.drug: VXA-102 - EpCAM x TAA x CD3 BiTAC T-cell engager (VXA-901 FLT3 mAb offered for partnering)
rows.cat: Partnering of VXA-901 / HER2 ADC; VXA-102 non-clinical progress toward IND/CTA readiness early 2028
rows.pitch: Veraxa now leads with VXA-102, a preclinical EpCAM x TAA x CD3 T-cell engager (IND ~2028); the FLT3 antibody is offered for partnering. A $148M cap is 3.7x its $40M cash with funding from notes and a purchase agreement, so dilution is the base case.

rows.name: Satellos
rows.drug: Forazapadin (SAT-3247, renamed) — oral AAK1 inhibitor (muscle regeneration)
rows.cat: BASECAMP Ph2 topline Q1 2027; TRAILHEAD adult 12-month data by end 2026
rows.pitch: Open-label grip gains and a 49.7% to 46.0% fat-fraction dip in 4 adults are the hook; the placebo-controlled BASECAMP Ph2 reads Q1 2027. Cash of $53M is 33% of the $159M cap, so funding is needed, and the stock is up ~12x in a year.

rows.name: Yarrow
rows.cat: Graves' Disease Phase 2a proof-of-concept data
rows.pitch: YB-101 (anti-TSHR, Fast Track) is dosing but has no efficacy data until 2H 2027; $490M cap is 2.2x the $225M weighted peak, softened by $269M cash and runway into 2030. A wait for Ph2a proof of concept.

rows.name: Alnylam
rows.indication: ATTR amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM) and hATTR polyneuropathy
rows.cat: ALN-6400 HHT Ph2 data with Q4/FY2026 results (Feb 2027); brezosiran pivotal start 2027
rows.pitch: Amvuttra did $1.13B in Q3 (total TTR $1.15B, +59%) on 2026 guidance of $4.2-4.5B, yet a $21B cap is 1.8x the $12B peak estimate against tafamidis generics and acoramidis; fully priced.

rows.name: Insmed
rows.cat: Arikayce sNDA (MAC lung disease) FDA decision, priority review, PDUFA Jan 28 2027; no AdCom planned
rows.pitch: Brinsupri sold $400.1M in Q3 (+29% q/q) with 2026 guidance of $1.35-1.40B and an Arikayce PDUFA Jan 28 2027; still, a $27B cap is 3.5x peak and shares are down 38% over 12 months.

rows.name: BioNTech
rows.cat: Pumitamig ROSETTA Phase 3 progress and first late-stage readouts
rows.pitch: Cash of $18.6B covers 88% of the $21B cap, so little is paid for pumitamig, whose seven Ph3 trials have no randomized data yet; 2026 revenue guide was raised to EUR 1.7-1.9B and ivonescimab leads the class.

rows.name: ADARx
rows.cat: STOP-HAE Phase 3 topline, guided by year-end 2027
rows.pitch: Cash is 60% of the $1.5B cap, but human efficacy is n=3 open-label; the cap is 2.7x our $560M weighted peak, and Ph3 STOP-HAE (~90 pts) reads out by YE2027 against Takeda and Ionis.

rows.name: Korsana
rows.cat: Phase 1 healthy-volunteer data
rows.pitch: No human data until Ph1 healthy-volunteer results in mid-2027; a $1.8B cap already assumes the shuttle works and beats Roche's Ph3 trontinemab; $456M cash funds into 2029.

rows.name: Harrow
rows.cat: NATACYN blepharitis initial data Q4 2026; G-MELT NDA submission by YE2026; IHEEZO QUELL full data Jan 2027
rows.pitch: Revenue of $99.3M in Q3 and a reaffirmed $350-365M guide show VEVYE working (+75%), but $293M of debt vs $75M of cash and a crowded dry-eye field keep the $1.1B cap fairly priced.

rows.name: Electra
rows.cat: SURPASS enrollment complete 2H 2027; topline date not stated
rows.pitch: The market pays ~$119M over $403M cash for ipsoprubart: 100% 8-week survival vs ~50% historical in n=12, but SURPASS is single-arm with an external control FDA/EMA may not accept; enrollment ends 2H 2027.

rows.name: TRexBio
rows.cat: TRB-061 Ph1b AD topline (mid-2027)
rows.pitch: Ph1a showed tolerability and Treg activation only; with cash at ~58% of the cap and a crowded AD field, there is little to do until the randomized Ph1b reads mid-2027.

rows.name: Iambic
rows.drug: IAM1363 (IAM-1363) - oral brain-penetrant, HER2-selective type 2 TKI
rows.indication: HER2-altered advanced solid tumors (basket Ph1/1b; amplified, mutant and overexpressing)
rows.cat: IAM-C1 IND Q4 2026; IAM1363 registrational HER2+ BC study start 2027 (subject to FDA)
rows.pitch: IAM1363 shows 36% systemic PR (19/53) and 41% intracranial PR (9/22) with 5.9% grade 3 TRAEs, but the field is crowded (zongertinib, T-DXd, tucatinib). $208M cash is 74% of the $280M cap; shares were below the $16 IPO price.

rows.name: Lycia
rows.drug: LCA-0061 - SC IgE-degrading cataLYTAC (anti-IgE with lysosome-targeting receptor engagement)
rows.indication: Food allergy (lead); also allergic asthma, allergic rhinitis, CSU, CRSwNP
rows.cat: Phase 1 data in elevated-IgE participants and food-allergy patients; Q3 results/10-Q
rows.pitch: A $1.6B cap after an October IPO rests on 96% free-IgE cut in ~8 healthy atopics (per press), 15x our $108M PoS-weighted peak; Xolair already depletes IgE and lock-up expiry looms.

rows.name: City Tx
rows.drug: CITY-FXI — GalNAc-conjugated siRNA silencing hepatic Factor XI
rows.indication: Thromboembolic disease (VTE prophylaxis, first Phase 2 in total knee arthroplasty)
rows.cat: CITY-FXI Ph1 SAD data (healthy + FV Leiden/prothrombin cohort) ASH oral 12/12/26
rows.pitch: Biomarker-only Ph1 (85% FXI knockdown, no bleeding or VTE endpoints) in a field led by Bayer, BMS/J&J and Anthos/Novartis; the $968M cap is 6.8x cash of $142M with 4.7 quarters of runway. ASH data Dec 12.

rows.name: Windward
rows.cat: POLARIS-1 Phase 2 primary results (week 24)
rows.pitch: Interim POLARIS-1 shows FEV1 up to +267 mL (p=0.033, n=147, no head-to-head vs Tezspire). $1.0B cap is ~1.7x the $600M weighted peak; week-24 primary 1H27, Ph3 topline not until 1H29.

rows.name: Aspen
rows.drug: Sasineprocel (ANPD001) -- autologous iPSC-derived dopaminergic neural progenitor cells, single bilateral intraputaminal injection
rows.cat: Phase 3 first patient dosing (biopsy collection starts by end-2026); FDA Ph3 design feedback
rows.pitch: Open-label n=15 shows no graft dyskinesia and gains beyond benchmarks at 18-24 months, with RMAT and Fast Track; with ~4 high-dose pts at 18 months and PD sham effects large, wait for Ph3 design feedback.

rows.name: Bambusa
rows.drug: BBT001 -- long-acting IL-4Ra x IL-31 bispecific antibody
rows.indication: Moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis (also CSU, prurigo nodularis, others)
rows.cat: 12-week SubQ PoC in bio-naive and bio-experienced AD, 14-week CSU PoC (H1 2027); Ph2b AD start-up by end-2026; est. lock-up expiry ~27 Apr 2027.
rows.pitch: BBT001's Ph1 (n=17, 4-week IV; wk6 placebo-adjusted EASI-75 64%) is early and not head-to-head with Dupixent. An $814M cap is ~3.4x our $240M probability-weighted peak, with 12-week SubQ data not until H1 2027 and lock-up expiry ~Apr 27.
